title: Project Manager
description:

Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 3–4 engineers supporting healthcare interfaces
  • Coordinate project delivery and ensure work stays on track and on schedule
  • Work directly with the client, providing regular updates and ensuring alignment on priorities
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and potential issues early, and drive them to resolution
  • Coordinate activities across engineering, business, and client stakeholders
  • Support future team and project expansion as additional initiatives are launched

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience managing software development or support projects
  • Experience coordinating multiple workstreams and stakeholders
  • Strong delivery management and organizational skills
  • Technical background to communicate effectively with engineers and understand technical discussions
  • Excellent communication and client-facing skills
  • Ability to work independently and proactively

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the healthcare domain

About Us

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, we have a global team of over 1,000 professionals and delivery centers across Europe, the United States, and Argentina. We partner with leading global brands, delivering innovative digital solutions across Fintech, Professional Services, Logistics, Healthcare, and Agriculture.

Our operations are driven by a strong business vision, a people-first culture, and a commitment to responsible growth. We actively give back to the community through various CSR activities and adhere to international principles for sustainable development and business ethics.

title: Lead Analytics Product & Services "Data Platform" F/M/X
description:
Accor Tech & Digital is the innovation and technological transformation lab of the world leader in hospitality.

Our teams, known as Heartists®, bring together the best of hospitality with the best of tech and digital. Our ambition is to provide our customers with personalized, memorable, and sustainable experiences.

Here, we create new ways to travel within each of our 5,500 hotels, connecting closely with our 100 million clients in 110 countries.

Here, we are at the heart of an incredible playground for technological transition and the design of digital products and services for our customers and hotel teams.

Here, your scope will know no boundaries;

So join us and dare to make an impact on the world!

Here is where your greatest challenge awaits you:

Within the Data Platform Tribe in the Data team, you will join a cross-functional organization whose mission is to provide a reliable, secure, and scalable technological foundation for all of the Group’s data needs. This platform supports Accor’s data democratization strategy by ensuring simple, governed, and high-performance access to analytical tools and services on an international scale.

The role is part of a team dedicated to analytics solutions for business users, responsible for providing, managing, and evolving the tools that enable data access and the consumption of analytical products. The team plays a key role in structuring the Group’s analytics ecosystem, continuously improving the user experience, and supporting Business Analysts in mastering their tools.

Your mission:

You will be responsible for data accessibility and democratization solutions at Accor and will be in charge of:

1) Operationally leading the Feature Team named OPEN, including:

  • Participating in the recruitment and training of the Feature Team developers

  • Managing relationships with technical representatives from third-party solution providers

2) Designing, delivering & maintaining products within the OPEN Feature Team portfolio, including:

  • Collaborating with the Product Owner and the other two Feature Teams within the Data Platform Tribe to ensure technical consistency and full functional coverage across the stack

  • Designing products to measure DATA ROI, i.e., both the operational costs generated by the platform and the value created by the Data products published by other Data Tribes

  • Contributing to the evolution of the Data Portal in partnership with two other major French groups, which serves as the main entry point for all users to access our products

  • Monitoring, analyzing, and resolving incidents or anomalies occurring on the Feature Team’s products and solutions

  • Implementing technological watch to continuously enrich our modern data stack

3) Ensuring a high level of service for users by implementing:

  • A solution to automate our BI administration

  • Training sessions for internal DATA department teams

  • Clear onboarding paths to facilitate adoption by internal DATA department teams

4) Educating and supporting all users by:

  • Helping them define needs not covered by the current stack

  • Participating in the animation of the “Data Tech” community (sharing best practices, code knowledge, technology watch, etc.)

  • Raising awareness among stakeholders about DATA challenges and benefits

And you?

  • Proven (senior) experience in enterprise-scale Data/BI environments, including implementing or evolving self-analytics solutions for a large user base

  • Experience in technical leadership: operational management of consultants or project teams, while remaining a strong individual contributor

Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise in Snowflake (core of the platform) and solid knowledge of its ecosystem

  • Experience with major analytical tools such as Tableau, Dataiku, and orchestration tools (e.g., Astronomer/Airflow)

  • Advanced expertise in data modeling and designing robust analytical models

  • Experience in BI tool administration and industrialization, with an automation-oriented approach

  • Advanced SQL and database skills; experience in data transformation (dbt knowledge is a plus)

  • Good understanding of semantic layer concepts and modern analytics architecture

  • Hands-on experience in managing and optimizing Business Intelligence tools (reporting, pagination, environment structuring)

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and pedagogical skills, with a strong user-service orientation

  • Technical lead mindset, capable of defending convictions and influencing diverse stakeholders

  • Continuous improvement and process automation mindset

  • Ability to simplify complex technical topics for non-technical audiences

  • Autonomy, rigor, and ability to thrive in a cross-functional and collaborative environment

Accor dares to impact:

- The world:

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.

  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the impact of digital on the environment across all our projects.

- Your career:

  • We enable all our employees to manage their work-life balance and offer them the means to shape their work environment according to their preferences.

  • Training and career paths are defined both individually and collectively, allowing us to grow together on a daily basis.

- Specifically, at Accor Tech & Digital:

  • Remote work available several days per week from France, with flexible work options: work from home, from our offices, or even from our hotels and coworking spaces through Worklib.

  • Every Wednesday afternoon, dedicate your time to deep work and personal development.

  • Work in a multicultural and English-speaking environment.

  • Continuous improvement & training: hackathons, exceptional technology partnerships, dedicated talent management, certifications and a dedicated learning platform.

and also,

  • ALL - Heartist® Program: unforgettable stays and experiences at all Accor locations and partner venues worldwide.

  • Heartist® for Good Program: commit to supporting an association of your choice from those available on our volunteering platform (1 day offered per year by the Group during your working hours).

  • An Employee Social Committee (CSE) supporting the financing of your cultural and sports activities.

  • Sustainable Mobility Package for the use of eco-friendly transportation or access to a company bike program in partnership with Zenride.

  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, in accordance with the rates set by French law “Loi Finance”.

  • €11 meal vouchers.

  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor without additional costs in case of enrollment of your dependents.

  • Attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, and recreational areas as well as wellness and sports facilities, on-site or through Gymlib.

Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, including those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, regardless of gender, so go ahead and apply!

Recruitment is all about people!

Is this mission appealing to you? Apply, and we will offer you:

  1. A meeting with our recruitment team to present the essential aspects of the position to you or guide you towards the role that may suit you.

  2. An interview with the team manager responsible for the role you are interested in.

  3. For some roles, you might also be required to complete an assessment (use case and motivation questionnaire.

  4. A final interview with our Human Resources team to discuss our Group's culture, work environment, training program, career prospects, as well as various benefits offered by the Group.

  5. A personalized feedback.

title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (Backend-focused, Java/Spring Boot)

Requirements

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

Benefits

  • High Impact Committees.

title: GROUNDS MAINTENANCE
description:
Landscapes Golf Management and Fountain Head Country Club are seeking dedicated Grounds Maintenance team members to join our team for the upcoming the golf season. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals who enjoy working outdoors and are passionate about maintaining beautiful landscapes. These are seasonal positions with up to full time hours.


Learn more about Fountain Head Country Club at


Our Values Bring Us Together; Our Expertise Sets Us Apart. We at LGM believe these values are instrumental to our daily operations. LGM Values: Do the Right Thing, Take Care of Each Other, Find a Way, Lead, Be the Best

To learn more about Landscapes Golf Management visit www.landscapesgolf.com .


JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for performing the tasks associated with the daily maintenance of the golf course, associated grounds, and project implementation.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  1. Operates mowing equipment; mows greens, tees, fairways, rough, bunker banks and native grass.
  2. Performs bunker maintenance; rakes and moves sand, edges, and pulls weeds.
  3. Ensures that all areas around trees, bunkers, cart paths, signs and other golf course features are maintained and edged.
  4. Installs and maintains landscaping plant material and performs all associated landscaping duties.
  5. Assists with the repairs and maintenance of the irrigation system features.
  6. Performs golf course set up; cup cutting, tee cleanup, divot filling, ball mark repair, trash and debris removal, and golf ball washer maintenance.
  7. Cleans, fuels, and stores equipment after each use. Refreshes oil and other lubricants as directed by the equipment technician. Reports equipment problems promptly to the appropriate supervisor.
  8. Possesses an understanding of the equipment and how to best maintain it for maximum life and minimum downtime.
  9. Complies with golf course etiquette rules.
  10. Must be well mannered, display a smile at all times, greet guests, member and fellow employees when encountered, show appreciation to the guests and the members, and demonstrate a willingness to help guests and members at all times.
  11. Possesses and understanding of the importance of safety and sees that safe operation procedures are observed in all daily activities. Adheres to the safety program.
  12. Demonstrates a commitment to the work and success of the club and the Company by being service- and solution-oriented, having positive interactions with all club staff and members/guests, and meeting established quality, service and safety expectations.
  13. Performs additional assignments per the direction of club or Company managers.
  14. Regular and punctual attendance on site for all scheduled shifts is required.

WORK HOURS AND CONDITIONS

Work hours may include early mornings and evenings on weekdays, weekends and holidays. Subject to inside and outside environmental conditions. May be exposed to inclement (non-threatening) weather, plant protection products, fertilizers, misdirected golf balls, and sharp and rapid equipment movement on a daily basis. Injury may result as a result of exposure to the above if safety policies and practices are not properly followed.

title: Senior Systems Engineer - EW
description:
** Due to the classified nature of our work, U.S. citizenship is required. Candidates must be willing to obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance.

Location: Nashua, NH; Dallas, TX

About Us

Pacific Defense, a small fast-growing company that develops and provides advanced multi-function RF systems for the U.S. Department of Defense, is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to work in our Electronic Warfare engineering team. As a member of the Pacific Defense group of companies, our growth is accelerating. Pacific Defense designs and builds advanced, military standards-based, modular open systems architecture (MOSA) systems. These systems conform to the Army's C4ISR Modular Open Suite of Standards (CMOSS) and the Air Force's Sensor Open Systems Architecture (SOSA) Standard. These CMOSS /SOSA systems are used for multi-mission electronic warfare, tactical communications, signals intelligence, cyber-EW, high performance computing and often simultaneous operation of these capabilities.

Who are we looking for?

Pacific Defense is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer - EW with the ability to lead and execute complex programs across the business. Pacific Defense has organized into an integrated CMOSS Solutions, Electronic Warfare and Space business areas. Within these business areas there are many products that support them including Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) products, Communications products (VLF through SHF and beyond), Electronic Warfare Systems, and others. This Systems Engineer will specialize in the Electronic Warfare business area but can support across all of them, dependent on the qualifications and desires of applicants and the needs of the business. Pacific Defense believes deeply in matching the job to the person.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Passion for both program startup and test and integration.
  • A proven drive for rigor in system and subsystem verification.
  • Skills needed for program startup including requirement generation, allocation, and verification.
  • Lab experience to support/lead the Integration and Test efforts up to and including verification/validation/acceptance with a focus on automation in testing.
  • Experience with Electronic Warfare (comms and/or non-comms), PNT, and Communications waveforms.
  • Proven field experience that demonstrates the ability to understand customer use cases and to rapidly adapt to changing needs.
  • Perform supporting analysis needed for proposals and documentation.
  • Be a voice into the direction of product development and future pursuits.
  • Work solutions to program problems across the company.
  • Support new business initiatives as required to include contribution to technical content, distribution, and collection/validation of Engineering artifacts across all Engineering disciplines.
  • Mentorship and growth of System Engineers.

Required Skills

  • Communications and Non-Communications Electronic Support (ES) and Electronic Attack (EA) System development and deployment experience.
  • Communications and Non-Communications signal properties, their detection, measurement, identification, and degradation, disruption, and denial.
  • Expertise in EW System verification using standard test equipment and special purpose subsystems.
  • Strong preference for hands-on work.
  • Understanding of Open Systems standards and experience using them (SOSA, CMOSS, MORA, VICTORY).
  • Possess acute attention to detail and be proactive and self-motivating.
  • Willingness to help refine processes and procedures to optimize rapid but assured system realization in a growing small company atmosphere.
  • Experience with hardware architecture, specification, design, integration, and testing, especially transceivers, amplifier subsystems, and antenna subsystems
  • Ability to work with customers to develop and document system requirements.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of hardware engineering, electrical engineering, electronics, computer architectures, and software architecture.
  • Coordinate work to analyze and translate requirements into system architecture, hardware and software designs and interface specifications.
  • Ability to design, analyze, and evaluate hardware products.
  • Experience following processes to ensure quality and predictability of hardware development.
  • Develop models or simulations and apply advanced computer programs, analytical techniques, or control strategies to effectively meet requirements and resolve problems.
  • Critical thinker, with prudent risk tolerance to balance risk and technology with requirements, cost, and schedule.
  • Competitive spirit accepting of challenges with a willingness to learn and recover from mistakes.
  • Willingness to learn and explore on your own, and travel, when necessary, in support of business goals.
  • Strong desire to work at a smaller company free of many of the “big company” roadblocks.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills with experience presenting technical material.

Preferred Experience

  • 5+ years of experience
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or other relevant technical field.

Benefits

Pacific Defense provides competitive salaries and immediately vested 401K match. We provide 100% coverage options for the employee, and 75% coverage for dependents’ medical, dental, vision, and life insurance premiums, as well as a flexible spending account for incidental health care expenses. We offer paid time off and federal holidays to spend time with family, pursue outside interests, or just get some extra rest.

Pacific Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual

orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor.

title: Residential Security Officer- Ballynatray, County Waterford
description:
Residential Security Officer

Ballynatray Estate, County Waterford
Permanent | Full-Time

Join the Team at One of Ireland's Most Distinguished Private Estates

Ballynatray Estate is seeking an exceptional Residential Security Officer to join our dedicated estate security team.

Set within a beautiful and historic estate, this is a unique opportunity for a professional, discreet and highly motivated individual to play a key role in protecting the estate, its residents, guests, employees and assets.

We are looking for someone who takes pride in delivering a first-class security service and who can combine vigilance, sound judgement and excellent interpersonal skills to help maintain a safe, secure and welcoming environment.

If you are proactive, dependable and thrive in a varied role where no two days are the same, we would be delighted to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Residential Security Officer, you will be responsible for maintaining the security and integrity of Ballynatray Estate and its associated properties. Working closely with the Estate Security Manager and wider estate team, you will provide a professional and discreet security presence while supporting the day-to-day safety and smooth operation of the estate.

This role requires a high level of professionalism, discretion and flexibility, together with the ability to respond calmly and effectively to a range of situations. You will be trusted to work independently, make informed decisions and uphold the highest standards of security and service.

Key Responsibilities

You will:

  • Protect residents, family members, guests and estate assets.
  • Maintain the overall security integrity of the estate and associated properties.
  • Manage access control for visitors, contractors and deliveries.
  • Conduct regular security patrols across the estate by foot, vehicle and remote monitoring.
  • Monitor CCTV, alarm and fire detection systems.
  • Respond promptly and effectively to security incidents, emergencies and medical situations.
  • Manage intruder detection, intervention and trespass incidents.
  • Coordinate emergency procedures, including evacuations and lockdown protocols.
  • Investigate, record and report incidents, accidents and near misses.
  • Liaise professionally with contractors, consultants and external service providers.
  • Support estate events and guest reception activities when required.
  • Ensure compliance with estate policies, procedures and health and safety requirements.
  • Build positive working relationships across all areas of the estate.
  • Identify risks and opportunities for improvement, helping to maintain exceptional standards throughout the estate.

Requirements

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Professionalism, integrity and discretion at all times.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organisational and problem-solving abilities.
  • A calm and measured approach when dealing with incidents or conflict.
  • The ability to take ownership and responsibility for tasks.
  • A proactive, flexible and solutions-focused mindset.
  • Strong situational awareness and attention to detail.
  • The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team environment.
  • A commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
  • A customer-focused approach with the confidence to engage professionally with residents, guests, contractors and colleagues.

Essential Requirements

  • A valid Private Security Authority (PSA) licence, or eligibility to obtain one.
  • Full, clean driving licence.
  • Previous experience within residential security, estate security, hospitality security or a similar environment, or demonstrable transferable skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Good IT literacy, including Microsoft Office applications.
  • Willingness to undergo pre-employment screening, including reference and background checks where applicable.

Desirable Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience operating CCTV and alarm systems.
  • First Aid Responder (FAR) qualification or equivalent.
  • Experience working within private estates, luxury residential environments, hospitality or customer-facing security roles.
  • Experience in incident management and emergency response.
  • Knowledge of health and safety procedures and best practice.

Candidates must live within one hour travelling distance from Eircode P36.

Benefits

Why Join Ballynatray Estate?

At Ballynatray Estate, security is about far more than monitoring systems and responding to incidents. It is about creating a safe, welcoming and professional environment for residents, guests and colleagues while upholding the values and reputation of a distinguished private estate.

In return, we offer:

  • A unique and rewarding working environment.
  • A varied role with genuine responsibility and autonomy.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
  • A supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • The opportunity to contribute to the ongoing success and security of one of Ireland's most prestigious estates.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

Apply Today

If you are a professional security officer who values discretion, integrity and exceptional service, and you are looking for an opportunity to work within a unique and prestigious estate environment, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Ballynatray Estate is committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of background.

If you have any queries regarding the role or the selection process, please contact Richard Barnston, Security Operations Manager via richard.barnston@weybourne.co.uk.

title: Production Technician
description:

Production Technician III - Williamson, NY

title: Software Engineer - Compiler & Runtime
description:
At OQC, we aren’t just theorising about the future; we’re building it. Born from a philosophy of bold innovation, we’ve successfully transitioned quantum computing from an academic dream into a commercial reality. The most exciting thing is that we’re just getting started and we’ve recently closed our £260 million Series C funding round – the largest fundraise ever completed by a quantum computing company in Europe.

The Purpose

As a Software Engineer in our Compiler and Runtime team, you’ll build the software that helps turn quantum computing into a production reality. You’ll primarily develop new compiler and runtime features, using Python, C++, LLVM and related toolchains, while also evolving and improving our existing codebase.

Your work will directly contribute to how OQC’s quantum computers are developed, operated and used.

The Role

You’ll join the Compiler and Runtime team and take ownership of software development across the full lifecycle – from understanding requirements and designing solutions through to implementation, testing and delivery.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving technically challenging problems. You’ll spend most of your time developing new functionality, alongside targeted work on legacy code, debugging complex issues and continuously improving the quality and maintainability of our software.

You’ll collaborate closely with other engineers and internal stakeholders, contribute to technical decisions, and share your expertise to raise engineering capability across the team.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Develop new features and capabilities across OQC’s compiler and runtime software to solve complex problems in the production and operation of quantum computers.
  • Work with our research team to bring new algorithms to production.
  • Own assigned development work from requirements and technical design through implementation, testing and delivery.
  • Debug complex issues across development and production environments, driving problems through to resolution.
  • Evolve, maintain and improve existing code, balancing new feature development with targeted brownfield and legacy work.
  • Design and evaluate technical approaches, clearly articulating trade-offs around performance, complexity, maintainability and engineering effort.
  • Review and robustly test code, pair with other engineers, and share technical knowledge through mentoring, technical discussions and practical collaboration.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong Python and/or C++ programming skills.
  • Experience in compiler development.
  • Experience taking software projects or significant features through the full development lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of core computer science principles, including algorithms, data structures, software architecture and operating systems.
  • Experience debugging technically complex issues in development and/or production environments.
  • Ability to understand existing codebases and contribute effectively to both new development and legacy software.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on software quality, maintainability and performance.
  • Ability to communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers and wider stakeholders.

The 'Nice-to-Haves'

  • Hands-on experience with LLVM or similar compiler/toolchain technologies.
  • Experience working with QASM
  • Experience working outside your core software specialism when required.
  • Experience working within a Quantum computing environment

Why Join OQC

You will join a world-class team at the forefront of the next computational era. We offer a culture of bold innovation, the chance to work with unique lab infrastructure, and the opportunity to see your work redefine the limits of computation.

Learn more about our benefits and positive work culture here:

title: Hardware Engineering Manager
description:
About us

Food waste is a $1 trillion problem – costing the world over 1% of global GDP. We’re dead set on solving the problem and looking for people to help us achieve our mission. We, at Winnow, believe that food is far too valuable to waste, and that technology can transform the way we produce food. Our team is made of people who all share a passion for food and technology.

Winnow was founded in London in 2013 to help the hospitality industry prevent food waste through internet of things tools in the kitchen. We have worked with thousands of sites and are operating in over 90 countries around the world supported by our offices in London, Dubai, Singapore, Cluj-Napoca (Romania) and Chicago. We are a scale-up stage company with a strong base of clients who are rolling out our system globally. We have blue-chip customers including Accor Hotels, IKEA, IHG, Marriott, Compass Group and many others.

Winnow’s clients on average reduce waste by over 50% by value and sustain savings. Winnow works with hotels, universities and schools, staff restaurants, event/hospitality kitchens, buffets, pubs, and high street restaurants. Where the system is permanently adopted, pre-consumer waste value is reduced by 50% - 70% with no detrimental impact to the perceived quality or value of the offer to their customers. This represents a typical improvement of food cost savings of 3% to 8%, commonly a 40%+ increase in profitability for operations.

As the global leader in addressing food waste, we are committed to continue pushing the envelope on what technology can do to solve this problem. Winnow Vision, our new artificial intelligence-based technology, is trained to automatically track all food waste thrown away. It has won awards at the World Economic Forum and has received tremendous enthusiasm from our clients and the industry. You can read more about it on our website and this article in Forbes.

Other recent accolades saw Winnow listed in the 2025 Sunday Times Best Places to Work - a recognition based on feedback from our UK team. While this award is based in the UK, it reflects something global: a culture built on purpose, collaboration, and the belief that businesses can - and should - tackle real-world problems while being great places to work. Previous awards saw Winnow in the top 10 of the FoodTech 500 awards - the worlds first definitive list of the global entrepreneurial talent at the intersection between food, technology and sustainability, as well as winning Impact 50's most impactful companies to work for. You can read more about it here.

We are passionate about living our values and place them at the centre of everything we do. We are excited about like minded talent who share these values, joining us in our mission:

Equal parts head and heart. We’re both passionate and measured. We carefully balance the need for quick solutions and pragmatism with the ability to step back, take in the bigger picture and build for the long term.

Bravely honest. With each other, that means we’re a transparent organisation where healthy, respectful debate is encouraged. With our customers, we challenge them if we don’t think they’re achieving their goals, whether they be environmental or financial.

People of action. Done is better than perfect, and we learn by boldly doing then rapidly improving. We’re breaking new ground, so we know things might go wrong. But we judge ourselves and each other on our reaction and our resilience.

Bound by food. We’re a diverse bunch, but our belief in the value of food is the common thread in everything we do. With each other, we celebrate through our love and respect for food. With our customers, it means we work hard to develop creative tools to make it easy for chefs to value food.

Hungry and humble. Our product is revolutionary, our people are impressive, and we’re hungry for change. But, we’re just the catalyst for a bigger movement. We stay humble regardless of our success, and make chefs the heroes in this journey.

People and planet positive. We’re caretakers of the planet, helping to preserve and support it for now and the future. Our work already minimises the impact that the hospitality industry has on the planet, and we’re also committed to actively reducing our own footprint while doing so. We’re leaving the planet and its people better off than we found them.

This is an opportunity to join an exciting organisation and help us propel our growth at what are truly the most exciting and dynamic points in time in our business. You will work alongside a driven team who are motivated by building an exciting business and leaving the world a better place than we found it.

Requirements

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Hardware Engineering Manager to take strategic ownership of our hardware portfolio and devise and execute the strategy for scaling our hardware solutions. This is a hands-on leadership role where you will operate with significant autonomy: you will own the full product lifecycle from EVT through to MP, devise the hardware roadmap and system architecture, establish and embed world-class engineering processes, and take ownership of our Contract Manufacturer relationships and global supply chain strategy.

You will independently lead and mentor a Hardware team of three, holding full accountability for their development, performance, and delivery. You will challenge the status quo, identify opportunities to improve how we engineer and manufacture our hardware, and act as the ambassador for the hardware function across Winnow. You will translate our longer-term product vision into actionable tactical plans, and execute these plans with little guidance, escalating strategically where needed.

Reporting to the company Founder, you will make critical decisions around design direction, manufacturing partnerships, and supply chain strategy, while staying hands-on in the lab.

This is a full-time position, and is 100% office based. We are located in Farringdon, Central London and there will be occasional travel to customer sites or manufacturing partners.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Hardware Leadership & Product Lifecycle

  • Devise and execute the hardware roadmap and system architecture, independently prioritising development efforts and identifying where to invest R&D resources to scale active units into the thousands
  • Own the full product lifecycle end-to-end—from EVT through DVT, PVT, and MP - making tactical decisions about design trade-offs, cost reduction, and functionality without requiring approval on standard execution
  • Lead and mentor the Hardware team of three with full accountability for their performance, development, and delivery; proactively coach them through the complete hardware development process and empower them to solve problems independently
  • Establish and embed new engineering processes — such as job pack release protocols, version control systems for PCBA design, and design change management — that raise standards and scale across the organisation
  • Drive new product development from conception to field deployment, aggressively reducing landed costs whilst adding functionality and improving reliability

Manufacturing Strategy & Supply Chain Ownership

  • Take ownership of the Contract Manufacturer (CM) bid process and CM relationship strategy across domestic and overseas vendors, making independent decisions on vendor selection and negotiation with strategic input from finance and operations as needed
  • Establish and manage CM relationships end-to-end, overseeing PCBA manufacturing, full box-builds, comprehensive testing regimes, and quality assurance; challenge CM performance and drive continuous improvement
  • Build and execute a global supply chain strategy, identifying technology partners, assessing component suitability, negotiating commercial terms, and managing warranty and support contracts independently
  • Implement and evolve manufacturing best practices—including rigorous stock control, handling procedures, quality control, and traceability—establishing these as the standard across all manufacturing partners

Engineering Excellence, Compliance & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Navigate and independently manage global compliance testing and certification processes, including RF, EMC, and Safety standards (CE, UL, CSA, MET); own responsibility for maintaining and updating our compliance roadmap as products evolve

title: Group AI Product Manager | Growth
description:
This role requires a hybrid schedule and will be based in our Charlotte, NC headquarters (Tuesday through Thursday) and work fully remotely on Mondays and Fridays each week.

This role is not open to visa sponsorship or transfer of visa sponsorship including those on H1-B, F-1, OPT, STEM-OPT, or TN visa, nor is it available to work corp-to-corp.

Red Ventures Growth & Transformation empowers partners through a unique blend of high-scale proprietary distribution, data models, AI-enabled applications, and strategic client partnerships. We help our clients unlock significant and sustainable growth across the home services ecosystem, ranging from telecommunications and security to energy and home automation. As a Red Ventures company, we have more than 20 years of experience building strategic, long-standing relationships with some of the world’s most powerful brands across industries like financial services, retail, real estate, and entertainment.

We believe the next phase of advantage will come from integrated operating systems that connect decisioning, execution, intelligence, and governance into a shared foundation that improves over time. RVGT is investing in that future through our Growth Operating System, a set of reusable workflows, agents, context layers, and governance mechanisms designed to help our teams and our partners drive growth more efficiently, more intelligently, and at greater scale.

Our product organization transforms clients’ customer acquisition, retention, and operations through AI and ML. We are seeking a Group AI Product Manager to own digital for one of our largest clients. In this role, you will lead a team designing, building, deploying, and scaling AI-native products and agentic workflows that materially improve our client’s economics. You will translate partner objectives, business strategy, and experimentation insights into clear product roadmaps, while working directly with client stakeholders to shape solutions, align on priorities, and guide key product decisions.

We expect this leader to be deeply technical, analytically rigorous, and relentlessly curious. You should bring a strong grasp of data science practices, the ability to find signal in ambiguity, and the judgment to identify where AI can create meaningful value within the broader partner strategy. You are comfortable operating close to the details, solving complex analytical and technical problems, and being hands-on when needed to drive our hardest challenges.

This role will have significant visibility across our client services division. You will work closely with senior leaders across product, technology, and client teams and serve as a credible strategic partner to the client on the products you lead. You will bring strong product judgment, help stakeholders navigate complex decisions, and build confidence in the path from opportunity to measurable business impact.

What You'll Do

  • Identify & drive initiatives: Lead multiple AI product initiatives, ensuring alignment with product leadership, partner objectives, customer needs, and broader RVGT strategy. Develop business cases and assess feasibility, impact, and ROI in partnership with business and client stakeholders
  • Translate vision into action: Turn high-level strategy into actionable workstreams, defining sequencing, resourcing, and execution plans in partnership with product team members and cross-functional leads. Create clarity and alignment
  • Own outcomes: Own the P&L and business impact of your initiatives, communicating progress, ROI, risks, and opportunities to leadership and client partners, shaping the go-forward for each workstream to ensure it’s positioned to deliver meaningful impact, getting hands-on where necessary to unblock our hardest tasks and hurdles
  • Advance the Operating System: Build and deploy agentic workflows across your workstreams in partnership with our central teams. Ensure delivery learnings are turned into reusable capabilities that strengthen the broader system over time
  • Develop talent: Manage and develop 2+ product manager(s), creating specific plans, providing hands-on product and analytical support, delegating appropriate work, and instilling a performance-driven environment through clear expectations, regular feedback, and recognition of achievements

What We’re Looking For:

  • Commercially grounded: You bring an entrepreneurial mindset paired with strong commercial instincts, identifying where value can be unlocked and the levers that drive measurable improvements in business outcomes, connecting product decisions to both near-term value and long-term strategy
  • Relationship-driven: You build durable relationships with client counterparts and internal leaders, understanding their motivations and constraints, and using these partnerships to shape decisions, secure alignment, and accelerate impact
  • Technical fluency: You have a strong technical and data foundation that enables you to collaborate effectively with engineers and data scientists, understand relevant algorithms, translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders, and leverage modern AI tools to accelerate product development
  • Customer centric: High-level of customer empathy with the ability to diagnose the core of the problem. You have a great taste for UX and design to help bring solutions to life
  • Deeply curious: You have a genuine drive to understand how the world is changing and how emerging AI capabilities can be applied in practice. You invest time in staying close to new developments, forming clear opinions on what makes systems effective, and bringing that perspective into product strategy, team leadership, and execution

Experiences You've Had:

  • End-to-end ownership: Experience driving AI/ML products from concept through iteration, guiding a team through delivery, and owning the outcomes and business impact of the work
  • Driving complex decision-making: Experience influencing cross-functional leaders, navigating competing priorities, and making high-impact product decisions in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Built from experience: You’ve worked hands-on with production-grade AI systems, whether evaluating model behavior, running analyses (sql, python), building agents, or optimizing data pipelines, giving you the practical grounding to lead teams and make informed technical decisions
  • Partner engagement: Experience serving as a strategic partner to stakeholders or clients, leading discovery conversations, validating opportunities, and aligning teams around shared goals
  • People leader: Managed junior product managers (or adjacent roles) with direct responsibility for their development and success

Compensation:

Total Cash Compensation Range: $185,000-$230,000

This role is eligible for a target bonus, which is included in the Total Cash Compensation Range above. This role is also eligible for Equity, which is offered separately from the Total Cash Compensation Range listed above. Actual compensation varies based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Additionally, the following benefits are provided by Red Ventures, subject to eligibility requirements.

  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Holiday Pay
  • 401(k) with match
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO): We believe time to rest and recharge is essential. That’s why we offer a generous and flexible PTO policy. Full-time employees accrue 20 days of PTO for a full calendar year annually, with an increase to 25 days after five years of service.

Who We Are:

Red Ventures is a global portfolio of high-growth companies — spanning several U.S. businesses, a joint venture in the health services industry, and strategic investments in Europe. Their businesses include The Points Guy, Lonely Planet, Bankrate, the Allconnect Platform, RV Home Client Growth, RV Growth & Transformation, Sage Home Loans Corporation, and more. Across the portfolio, Red Ventures businesses deliver seamless digital experiences for consumers, help Fortune 100 clients solve large-scale digital growth challenges, and create world-class experiences and opportunities for employees. title: Process Engineering Consultant
description:
Assala Energy is seeking the provision of specialist process engineering consultancy services to support its Projects portfolio. The engagement will focus on the delivery of process engineering studies, technical assessments, design deliverables, and recommendations associated with field development and asset optimisation activities within Assala Energy's operated assets in Gabon.

The Supplier shall provide suitably qualified personnel, expertise, methods, and tools necessary to deliver the agreed services and outputs. The Supplier shall retain discretion over how the services are delivered, subject to the achievement of agreed deliverables, milestones, and technical requirements.

Scope 1: Field Development Services

The Supplier shall provide process engineering services including, but not limited to:

  • Generation and technical evaluation of field development concepts using available production, reservoir, and geoscience data.
  • Preparation of process engineering studies and assessments to support concept selection and project maturation activities.
  • Development of process design deliverables across conceptual, FEED, and detailed design phases.
  • Preparation, review, and issue of process engineering documentation, calculations, reports, and technical specifications required to support project decision-making.
  • Provision of technical reviews and recommendations relating to vendor and contractor deliverables.
  • Participation in multidisciplinary technical reviews to ensure integration of process engineering requirements into project solutions.
  • Provision of technical input supporting project cost estimates, schedules, and execution planning.
  • Preparation and presentation of technical findings, engineering studies, and recommendations to designated stakeholders.
  • Identification and compilation of final process engineering documentation required for project close-out and handover.

Deliverables

Typical deliverables may include:

  • Process engineering reports.
  • Concept evaluation studies.
  • Process simulations and supporting calculations.
  • PFDs and P&IDs reviews.
  • Technical specifications and datasheets.
  • Engineering recommendations and decision-support documents.
  • Close-out and handover documentation.

Scope 2: Asset Optimisation Services

The Supplier shall provide process engineering consultancy services to identify and support implementation of opportunities to enhance the performance of mature producing assets, including:

  • Technical review of existing facilities, process systems, and operational performance.
  • Identification, assessment, and ranking of opportunities to improve production efficiency, throughput, reliability, and crude export performance.
  • Preparation of technical studies and engineering deliverables supporting recommended optimisation opportunities.
  • Provision of technical support throughout the development and implementation of selected optimisation solutions.
  • Development of process engineering documentation necessary to progress projects through applicable assurance and approval stages.
  • Technical engagement with operational and project stakeholders to facilitate understanding and implementation of proposed solutions.

Deliverables

Typical deliverables may include:

  • Asset performance assessments.
  • Debottlenecking studies.
  • Process optimisation reports.
  • Simulation models and analyses.
  • Feasibility assessments.
  • Process design documentation.
  • Technical recommendations and implementation plans.

Requirements

The Consultant should be able to demonstrate the capability to deliver the following services and outcomes:

  • Provision of specialist process engineering expertise in support of onshore and offshore oil and gas projects.
  • Development and evaluation of field development concepts, including identification and assessment of opportunities for late-life asset optimisation.
  • Delivery of process engineering studies, technical assessments, and recommendations relating to oil and gas processing facilities and associated systems.
  • Production of engineering deliverables, reports, calculations, and technical documentation in accordance with agreed project requirements.
  • Application of industry-recognised engineering methodologies, standards, and best practices to support safe, practical, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Utilisation of appropriate engineering and process simulation software, including but not limited to Unisim, Flare System Analyser, and Flaresim, where required to support the delivery of agreed outputs.
  • Effective engagement with relevant project stakeholders to communicate findings, present recommendations, and support the delivery of agreed project objectives.
  • Delivery of services with a focus on innovation, technical quality, safety, and achievement of agreed milestones and outcomes.

title: Marine Surveyor
description:
The Marine Surveyor will supervise and perform marine inspections for one or different branches. Also performing marine surveys, including vessel draft surveys, barge surveys, on/off hire condition surveys, and product inspections for vessels carrying a variety of dry bulk cargo and petroleum-based products utilizing draft surveying techniques such as draft immersion and on/off hire surveys.

This role must develop a robust communications network in order to schedule timely draft surveys. The Marine Surveyor must adhere to SGS Health and Safety policies at all times.


• The Marine Surveyor is accountable for managing all aspects of the jobs as required and for ensuring that the Regional Manager is kept current and informed on all aspects of the activities that have any direct or indirect impact on financial, quality and
• Performing vessel draft surveys, barge surveys, on/off hire condition surveys, and product inspections for vessels carrying a variety of products, including coal, fertilizer, cement, steel and petroleum-based products
• Performing Marine Cargo inspections on a variety of bulk cargo products via vessel and/or barge draft surveys and physical/visual examination, as deemed necessary. Using accepted draft surveying techniques (draft immersion) to calculate quantities of cargo loaded or discharged from vessels.
• Conducting on/off hire Ship condition surveys, cargo Hold inspection surveys and Bunker surveys for various marine vessel, as applicable in the Trade Industry; utilizing knowledge of ship construction, stability, terminologies and routines., as well as SGS's standard inspection and quality management procedures to conduct marine survey work.
• Utilizing SGS Patented Draft Survey Tool and SGS standard methods of inspection/reporting procedures to draft survey reports, on/off hire surveys, bunker surveys. Including understanding documents for certificates of weight, certificates of analysis, and certificates of hold cleanliness and tightness, etc.
• Providing reports to clients in standard format and in accordance with corporate quality programs, policies and procedures; Using the SIR Platform
• Utilizing knowledge of ship construction, stability, terms and routines, as well as SGS’s standard inspection and quality management procedures to supervise conducting marine surveys.
• Using sophisticated draft surveying techniques (e.g. draft immersion) to calculate quantities of cargo loaded or discharged from vessels, taking into account any changes in weight that may take place during cargo operation.
• Overseeing cargo sampling and analysis and inspecting cargo holds.
• Using SGS specialized methods and reporting procedures to develop draft survey reports (including certificates of weight, certificates of analysis, and certificates of hold cleanliness and tightness).
• Liase with terminal and warehouse personal for execution of inspections; Communicate and give direction to the administrative/branch staff regarding inspection details
• Providing expert opinions and guidance to clients on hull, cargo damage, cargo holding cleanliness and overall risk assessment to minimize the client’s financial risks and liability.
• Utilizing sampling and analysis methods and techniques to perform product/cargo inspections and ensure adherence with safety and environmental standards.

• Associates degree AND
• 4+ years of experience as a Marine/Cargo Surveyor.
• Previous demonstrated experience in harbor operations.
• Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Marine Engineering, Structural, Chemical, Naval, Mechanical,Civil Engineering, Mining or related field, plus 4+ years of experience in the job offered or in an occupation which includes required experience/skills.
• Experience must include four years of experience in marine surveying methodologies; four years of experience with performing marine surveys, including vessel draft surveys, barge surveys, on/off hire condition surveys, and product inspections for vessels carrying a variety of dry bulk cargo and/or petroleum-based products;
• 4+ years of experience utilizing draft surveying techniques such as draft immersion to calculate quantities of cargo loaded or discharged from vessels, taking into account any changes in weight that may take place during cargo operation;
• 4+ years of experience with inspecting vessels’ overall construction, machinery, equipment and cargo to insure they meet governmental and international maritime and environmental regulations;
• 4+ years of experience overseeing cargo sampling and analysis and inspecting cargo holds;
• 4+ years of experience with logistic management including vessel, terminal, charter party, cargo supplier, agent and customer;

title: Digital Content Designer
description:
Company Overview

LTF is one of the UK’s leading digital growth partners for medical aesthetics, cosmetic surgery and dental clinics. We work with ambitious clinics across the UK, Europe and North America to help them attract more patients through industry-leading digital marketing.

Unlike traditional marketing agencies, our approach combines strategy, creativity, performance marketing and commercial insight to build long-term growth for our clients. Video has become one of the most powerful assets within that strategy.

Our team is passionate about creating impactful campaigns, delivering measurable results, and fostering strong client partnerships. We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and remote-friendly work environment where your contributions will make a difference.

Role Overview

The Digital Content Designer will be responsible for creating polished, performance-focused digital assets for both LTF and our clients.

This is not a basic Canva content role. We need someone with strong creative judgement, solid design fundamentals and advanced video editing ability. You will be expected to take raw footage, campaign briefs and brand guidelines and turn them into high-quality digital assets that feel premium, clear and commercially useful.

You will support organic social campaigns, paid media campaigns, website content, landing pages, email marketing, pitch decks, client presentations, display banners and video assets.

The role will work closely with Paid Media, SEO, CRO, Client Services and the wider Creative team to ensure every asset has a clear purpose. Some work will be brand building. Some will be conversion-focused. Some will be designed to stop the scroll, improve click-through rates or support website performance.

Requirements

Core Skill Requirements

Digital Design

  • Create high quality designs for websites, landing pages, paid media campaigns, organic social, email marketing, display banners and digital presentations.
  • Apply strong layout, typography, spacing, hierarchy and brand consistency across all creative work.
  • Design assets that feel premium, modern and appropriate for pharmaceutical, aesthetics, dental and healthcare audiences.

Video Editing

  • Edit video content to a strong professional standard using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or equivalent software.
  • Create short form video for Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and paid social campaigns.
  • Edit longer form website videos, treatment explainers, patient education videos, clinician introductions and campaign content.
  • Add captions, motion graphics, transitions, music, grading, sound balancing and branded visual elements.
  • Take video production beyond simple template based editing.

Motion Graphics

  • Create animated graphics, text overlays, transitions, logo animations and campaign visuals.
  • Use motion to improve engagement, retention and clarity across social and paid media content.
  • Support video assets with clean, branded and commercially useful animation.

Email Design

  • Design email marketing assets, newsletters, campaign emails and promotional layouts.
  • Create email visuals that support readability, click through rates and brand consistency.
  • Work with the team to ensure email creative aligns with client campaigns, seasonal offers and wider marketing activity.

Website and Landing Page Assets

  • Design website banners, treatment page visuals, campaign landing page graphics, homepage sections and supporting content blocks.
  • Work with CRO, SEO and development teams to ensure creative supports user experience, conversion and search performance.
  • Create assets that make websites feel more engaging without slowing down or cluttering the user journey.

Paid Media Creative

  • Produce performance focused assets for Meta Ads, Google Ads, display campaigns and retargeting.
  • Create multiple creative variations for testing different hooks, formats, layouts and messages.
  • Understand how creative impacts click through rate, conversion rate, lead quality and campaign performance.

Presentation and Deck Design

  • Design polished pitch decks, strategy presentations, client review decks and internal documents.
  • Turn complex ideas into clear visual slides that are easy to understand.
  • Support new business and client service teams with professional presentation assets.

Website Content

  • Produce website videos that improve user engagement and conversion rates.
  • Create homepage videos, treatment explainers, clinician introductions, patient journey videos and educational resources.
  • Work alongside the CRO and SEO teams to ensure video supports both search visibility and website performance.

Project Management

  • Plan production timelines.
  • Organise editing workloads.
  • Ensure all projects are delivered on time and within agreed service levels.
  • Maintain organised file structures and digital asset libraries.


General Deliverables and Responsibilities

  • Create digital assets for organic social, paid media, websites, emails, banners and presentations.
  • Edit high quality video content for both organic and paid campaigns.
  • Create motion graphics and branded video elements.
  • Design website and landing page assets that support user experience and conversion.
  • Produce campaign creative for Meta Ads, Google Ads and display activity.
  • Support LTF’s own marketing with social, website, sales and recruitment creative.
  • Work from client brand guidelines to maintain consistency across all visual output.
  • Collaborate with Paid Media Managers to test and improve campaign creative.
  • Work with SEO and CRO teams to make sure creative assets support wider performance goals.
  • Manage multiple creative briefs at the same time.
  • Keep design files, video files and exported assets organised.
  • Stay current with trends in video editing, social media design, motion graphics, AI creative tools and digital advertising formats.

Personal Attributes

  • Commercially minded with a strong understanding of how creative content drives business growth.
  • Highly organised and capable of managing multiple productions simultaneously.
  • Confident working directly with stakeholders and business owners.
  • Creative whilst remaining commercially focused.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong communicator with the confidence to influence both clients and colleagues.
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently within a remote team.
  • Adaptable and calm under pressure.
  • Passionate about continually improving creative standards.
  • Committed to delivering exceptional client experiences.

Qualifications

  • Minimum three years’ experience in digital design, content design, creative production or a similar role.
  • Strong portfolio showing digital design and video editing work.
  • Advanced video editing skills using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or equivalent.
  • Strong design skills using Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or equivalent design software.
  • Experience designing for social media, paid ads, websites and email campaigns.
  • Experience creating presentation decks and client facing documents.
  • Understanding of Meta Ads creative best practice would be advantageous.
  • Experience in aesthetics, dental, healthcare, beauty or wellness would be advantageous but is not essential.
  • Experience with photography, filming or editing video shoot footage would be beneficial.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience £30K -£37,500K PA.
  • 28 holiday days (excluding Public Holidays)
  • Bendenen Health Plan
  • Team event away days
  • Flexible working hours
  • Pension contributions
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression

title: Wellness Experience Executive
description:
MORROW HEALTH

MORROW Health is Singapore’s largest integrated fitness and recovery destination, designed to help individuals build healthier, more resilient lives through intentional daily habits. Grounded in lifestyle medicine, MORROW Health brings together physical activity, nutrition, restorative sleep, stress management, avoidance of risky substances, and social connection through structured programmes and purpose-built environments that make sustainable lifestyle change achievable. Supported by evidence-informed practice and data from wearables and lifestyle inputs, MORROW Health helps members recognise patterns, build consistency, and stay accountable—turning insight into everyday action that supports long-term vitality, strength, and clarity, without medical diagnosis or treatment.

Location: Singapore
Reports To: Membership Experience Manager

Role Overview

As a Wellness Experience Executive, you will be the first point of contact for our members and guests, playing a critical role in shaping their journey with us. You will manage daily queries, provide exceptional service recovery, and ensure every interaction reflects our brand values of care, wellness, and excellence.

This role goes beyond standard customer service — you will act as a brand ambassador, guiding members through our service offerings, resolving feedback promptly, and creating meaningful experiences that foster loyalty and retention.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle customer feedback, complaints, compliments, and inquiries with professionalism and empathy.
  • Provide accurate information on all service offerings (wellness, recovery, nutrition, and lifestyle facilities) to members and guests.
  • Manage and maintain merchandise inventory: monitor stock levels, ensure timely replenishment, oversee visual-merchandising standards and presentation of retail displays to uphold our brand experience.
  • Support the daily operations of the membership desk, including rostering coverage, queue management, and appointment scheduling.
  • Log, escalate, and follow up on service issues in line with SOPs, ensuring timely resolution and service recovery.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of promotions, membership packages, and new service launches.
  • Collect and relay member feedback to the Manager for continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Assist in the execution of member engagement activities, workshops, or events.
  • Ensure data accuracy when updating member records in the CRM system.
  • Uphold confidentiality, service consistency, and compliance with organisational standards.

Requirements

  • Diploma/Certificate in Hospitality, Business, Customer Service, or related field.
  • Minimum 1–3 years of experience in customer-facing roles, preferably in hospitality, healthcare, fitness, spa, or wellness environments.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a natural customer-first mindset.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure and resolve conflicts with professionalism.
  • Tech-savvy with experience using CRM or booking systems.
  • Team player who is adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in a startup environment.
  • Bonus: Prior experience in wellness-focused settings such as gyms, spas, recovery facilities, or health & lifestyle clubs.

Benefits

This is a career-defining opportunity to shape the future of longevity medicine while working alongside world-class clinicians and technologists. You will contribute to initiatives that directly lead to extending human healthspan while establishing Singapore as the global hub for longevity innovation.

At MORROW, you will not only help define operational excellence but also build the culture, rhythm, and future of interventions. You won't just be joining a team. You will be co-creating tomorrow.

MORROW Health Pte Ltd is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Exercise Scientist
description:
MORROW MEDICAL

MORROW Medical is a physician-led longevity and lifestyle medicine clinic in Singapore, focused on helping individuals understand, optimise, and protect their long-term health. We combine comprehensive health screening, preventive care, and evidence-based lifestyle medicine to identify early signs of metabolic, cardiovascular, and functional change—often before disease develops. Our fully licensed doctors diagnose conditions, prescribe medication, and manage chronic disease where required, while also guiding patients through personalised lifestyle interventions that support sustainable improvement. From preventive screening to ongoing medical management, MORROW Medical delivers integrated care designed to strengthen function, resilience, and long-term health outcomes.

Position: Exercise Scientist

Location: Singapore (Clinic-based)

Reports to: Head of Lifestyle Medicine / Head of Exercise Science

Works closely with: Group Movement Lead

Role Overview

We are seeking an Exercise Scientist to lead the assessment and evaluation of participants’ physical performance, with a focus on strength, power, functional capacity, and cardiorespiratory fitness. This role will be central to our clinical and lifestyle model of care, working within a multidisciplinary team of physicians, allied health, and health coaches to deliver actionable insights that shape precision health plans.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct and interpret strength and power testing, following set protocols and using digital tools.
  • Perform functional movement and performance assessments, integrating validated protocols for mobility, balance, and musculoskeletal function.
  • Administer VO₂ max and submaximal cardiorespiratory testing, ensuring safety, standardisation, and repeatability.
  • Generate data-driven, actionable reports for physicians, allied health, and clients, linking results to healthspan and longevity outcomes.
  • Collaborate in developing personalised exercise prescriptions and lifestyle interventions within multidisciplinary care plans.
  • Ensure testing protocols are evidence-based, standardised, and repeatable, while scalable across in-person and digital pathways.
  • Support research initiatives, including participation in protocol design, data collection, and clinical studies on exercise and longevity.
  • Contribute to patient education, onboarding workshops, and group/shared medical appointments.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and adhere to all clinical governance, safety, and compliance requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Exercise Science, Exercise Physiology, Sports Science, or equivalent.
  • Accreditation with Exercise & Sports Science Australia (ESSA), American College of Sports Medicine (ACSM), or equivalent recognised body.
  • Proven experience in conducting exercise and performance testing in a clinical, academic, or high-performance setting.
  • Strong knowledge of cardiopulmonary exercise testing (CPET), strength diagnostics, and functional assessment tools.
  • Familiarity with longevity, lifestyle medicine, and prevention-focused models is highly desirable.
  • Excellent communication skills to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both clinicians and clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to work within a multidisciplinary team, with empathy, professionalism, and patient-centred care.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to pioneer exercise science as a central pillar of a first-of-its-kind longevity and lifestyle medicine facility in Asia.
  • Access to world-class diagnostic technologies and an integrated clinical + lifestyle environment.
  • Collaborative, purpose-driven culture with values of Trust, Connection, Empowerment, and Impact.
  • Competitive remuneration and benefits, with opportunities for research, professional growth, and global collaborations.

Why Join Us
This is a career-defining opportunity to shape the future of longevity medicine while working alongside world-class clinicians and technologists. You will contribute to initiatives that directly lead to extending human healthspan while establishing Singapore as the global hub for longevity innovation.


At MORROW, you will not only help define operational excellence but also build the culture, rhythm, and future of interventions. You won't just be joining a team. You will be co-creating tomorrow.

MORROW Medical Pte Ltd is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

description:
Are you passionate about applying AI and compilation techniques to automate legal contract processing at AWS scale? The AWS Contract Onboarding team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to build systems that parse, interpret, and ingest Private Pricing Agreements - enabling AWS to bill customers accurately and sign contracts faster. You'll work with LLMs, distributed event pipelines, and customer-facing consoles processing billions of dollars in AWS revenue.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer, you will own all aspects of the software development lifecycle - design, architecture, implementation, testing, and operations. Your team builds systems to capture contractual data from AWS Private Pricing Agreements in electronic format, enabling automated billing at global scale.

In this role, you will...

  • Design and build contract parsing and term extraction pipelines using AI/LLM techniques.
  • Own and operate distributed systems processing confidential contractual data under demanding SLAs.
  • Build event-driven architectures using AWS services (Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, DynamoDB).
  • Collaborate with Product Managers and partner engineering teams to define scope and technical direction.
  • Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement.
  • Write high-quality, testable code in Java, Kotlin, Python, and TypeScript.
  • Build highly available, secure systems at Amazon scale.
  • Mentor and support the growth of other developers.

A day in the life
On a typical day, you might design an LLM extraction pipeline for a new contract type, debug a distributed event processing issue, review a teammate's architecture for a customer-facing API, or deep-dive into billing data to validate that automated discounts are applied correctly. You'll collaborate across and ship features that directly impact how AWS customers are billed. We move fast, own what we build, and measure our impact in contracts automated per day.

About the team
The Contract Onboarding team builds tools and services to auto-generate and auto-ingest AWS Private Pricing Agreements. We enable the AWS Billing organization to sign contracts faster, compute bills accurately, and apply customized discounts - enhancing the experience for AWS's largest customers. Our systems combine AI/LLM-powered contract parsing, distributed event processing, and customer-facing consoles to automate what was previously a manual, error-prone process.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
  • Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
  • Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
  • Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
  • Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
  • Experience designing, building, operating, and managing large-scale distributed systems or web services
  • Experience building rich data-driven web applications by consuming RESTful services and APIs
