title: Office Coordinator
description:
Stream is on a mission to bring financial wellbeing to all workers.

We partner with some of the world's most well-known employers, like Crate & Barrel, Driven Brands, General Electric, New Balance, Restaurant Brands International (RBI) and others, to give their teams access to fairer financial services. Over 3 million people track their shifts and earnings, start their first savings account, use budgeting tools, access financial education and choose when they want to get paid. All in one smartphone app.

Stream is unique: VC-backed and growing at scale-up pace, but with a social conscience. Some of the world's leading financial charities and impact funds were our founding investors.

You'd be joining a team of over 300 passionate, ambitious people across the UK, Europe and US, building a category-leading FinTech product with the mission to improve the lives of millions.

What you'll do

Our offices are a big part of how we work. They're where the team gets together, where we host customers and partners, and where a lot of our culture happens. As our NYC Office Coordinator, you'll run the day-to-day of our New York office and make it somewhere people look forward to coming into.

You'll also be responsible for our Arlington, VA office, with regular trips down to see the team there. It's a varied role with a lot of autonomy. We're growing quickly in the US and you'll have a real say in how our offices grow with us.

  • Employee experience. Host visitors, keep desks and meeting rooms set up and stocked, and spot what the team needs before they have to ask.

  • Events and hospitality. Run our team socials, external events and VIP visits from start to finish. You'll own the workplace and run events within budget, manage vendors and catering, and get the most out of what we spend.

  • Tech and facilities. Be the first port of call for basic office tech and facilities issues, and fix the small things before they get in anyone's way.

  • Office operations. Manage supplies, inventory and day-to-day vendors, keep the space in good shape, handle mail and deliveries, and look for simpler ways of doing things.

  • Multi-site ownership. Look after office operations in New York and Arlington so both teams get the same standard, with planned trips to VA when needed.

What you bring

  • Experience as an Office Coordinator, Workplace Manager or in a similar operations role.

  • You're a self-starter. You take the initiative, solve problems yourself and see things through without needing to be chased.

  • Comfortable with Google Workspace and Slack, and open to using AI tools to make the day-to-day easier.

  • Calm when things are busy, and happy to switch priorities when they change.

  • Great with people. You enjoy hosting, bringing people together and making the office feel welcoming.

  • Organized, with a sharp eye for detail.

  • You get on with things, especially when they're time-sensitive.

Location: New York, on-site 5 days a week, with regular travel to our Arlington, VA office.

Salary: The base salary range for this role is $60,000 to $70,000, plus equity and benefits.

Benefits

  • 15 days vacation in addition to federal holidays, as well as flexible time off allowances for any ad-hoc childcare/family/caring needs.

  • 12 weeks paid Maternity Leave and 2 weeks paid Paternity Leave for employees with over 12 months service.

  • Health, dental and vision benefits (a number of these are paid in full for the employee).

  • Swanky equipment, such as the latest Apple MacBooks.

  • We want to invest in you financially, so we have a 401K program.

And of course, the best benefit of all: access to Stream!

description:

**Must be IPC Certified

Location: Sunnyvale, CA

About Us

Pacific Defense is an industry leading developer of advanced RF and electronics systems for the U.S. Department of Defense and commercial customers. We specialize in Open Systems Architecture solutions for the non-kinetic fight. Our vision provides cost effective, highly capable, modular, and rapidly reconfigurable systems to our customers in less than half the time of traditional defense contractors. Our team delivers sensing and effects solutions for the Land, Air, Sea and Space domains at an unprecedented pace. We accomplish this strategy by combining broad domain experience in Radar, EW, SIGINT, and Communications with a go-fast commercial execution model. Our model fully leverages Open Standards, like SOSA, CMOSS, and MORA, as well as rapid prototyping methodologies to bring our advanced capabilities to customers. The Pacific Defense family includes Perceptronics Solutions with expertise spanning signal processing, novel algorithm development, cognitive systems, high performance computing, hardware design and development, and systems integration and test. We embrace the diversity of people, ideas, and a great employee experience to drive the innovation that runs through everything we do. Pacific Defense has established an excellent reputation in our professional community and is growing our team to seize new opportunities to solve tough challenges for national defense. Come join our team and accelerate your career!

Who are we looking for?

Pacific Defense is looking for a Automation Engineering Technician to support the Sunnyvale, CA location. The position includes engineering development, troubleshooting, production support, and maintaining complex instrumentation to ensure reliability, configuration control, and specifications.

Requirements

  • Experience with reading/interpreting drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), and complex assembly instructions in order to assemble PCBs
  • Experience with Python and Linux
  • Duties include installation of connectors, substrates, components and modules in highly complex microwave assemblies, often utilizing using paste and sheet epoxies
  • Experience solder both SMT and through hole parts onto PCBs
  • Operate autonomous without direct engineering or management oversite
  • Proven experience transitioning products from design to manufacturing as part of a cross-functional team
  • Demonstrated experience in fast-paced iterative design environments with complex RF and high-speed digital processing electronic products and associated software and gateware
  • Demonstrated experience with reviewing hardware designs to define test coverage
  • Proven ability in communicating project status and updates across departments and disciplines
  • Self-starter, with ability to work within teams or as an individual contributor to accomplish design goals
  • Excellent communication (oral and written) with all levels; collaboration, organizational, and prioritization skills
  • Ability to read, understand, and apply schematics and assembly drawings
  • Solder fine electronics on printed circuit cards, wires, and assemblies
  • Develop and troubleshoot electronics systems from incomplete information
  • Must be IPC certified

Responsibilities

  • Use schematics, blueprints or sketches and verbal and written
    instructions to assemble, rework, or re-assemble units
  • Hand solder components onto PCBs
  • Perform rework (i.e. 0201 size parts) and PCB modifications as needed
  • Perform surface mount, fine pitch and through hole soldering
  • Perform other duties assisting with PCB assembly as required
  • Able to attach wires to load cell tabs by following schematics or wiring diagrams
  • Able to work with precision and follow standardized, existing procedures
  • Able to work with miniaturized tools such as tweezers, fine screwdrivers and soldering irons
  • Write or modify a board level test procedure with guidance from design engineer
  • Collect and organize RF characterization and test data, follow test procedures and instructions for the completion of assigned tasks
  • Clearly communicate status using the established collaboration tools
  • Demonstrate the ability to organize information, job tasks, and manage time for most efficient and "best value" performance

Education

  • High School diploma or equivalent plus 6 years experience or a relevant 2-year technical degree plus 4 years or more relevant experience or any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Benefits

What we can offer you:

Pacific Defense provides competitive salaries and immediately vested 401K match. We provide 100% coverage for the employee, and 75% coverage for dependents’ medical, dental, vision, and life insurance premiums, as well as a flexible spending account for incidental health care expenses. We offer paid time off and federal holidays to spend time with family, pursue outside interests, or just get some extra rest.

Pacific Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor.

title: GROUNDS MAINTENANCE
description:
Landscapes Golf Management and Heritage Hunt Golf & Country Club are seeking individuals to join our Grounds Maintenance team for the golf season. This role is essential in maintaining the beauty and functionality of our golf course and surrounding areas. Must be at least 16 years of age at the time of hire.

Heritage Hunt is an active adult community for residents 55 years and older. Heritage Hunt covers over 750 acres of beautiful, natural landscaping and has its own, Arthur Hills designed, 18-hole championship golf course, two clubhouses, tennis courts, indoor and outdoor swimming pools, and multiple choices of home styles. Gated with a single entry point, it's a community that offers natural beauty, a wide variety of home selections, and a wide variety of amenities.

Our Values Bring Us Together; Our Expertise Sets Us Apart. We at LGM believe these values are instrumental to our daily operations. LGM Values: Do the Right Thing, Take Care of Each Other, Find a Way, Lead, Be the Best

To learn more about Landscapes Golf Management visit www.landscapesgolf.com .


JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for performing the tasks associated with the daily maintenance of the golf course, associated grounds, and project implementation.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  1. Operates mowing equipment; mows greens, tees, fairways, rough, bunker banks and native grass.
  2. Performs bunker maintenance; rakes and moves sand, edges, and pulls weeds.
  3. Ensures that all areas around trees, bunkers, cart paths, signs and other golf course features are maintained and edged.
  4. Installs and maintains landscaping plant material and performs all associated landscaping duties.
  5. Assists with the repairs and maintenance of the irrigation system features.
  6. Performs golf course set up; cup cutting, tee cleanup, divot filling, ball mark repair, trash and debris removal, and golf ball washer maintenance.
  7. Cleans, fuels, and stores equipment after each use. Refreshes oil and other lubricants as directed by the equipment technician. Reports equipment problems promptly to the appropriate supervisor.
  8. Possesses an understanding of the equipment and how to best maintain it for maximum life and minimum downtime.
  9. Complies with golf course etiquette rules.
  10. Must be well mannered, display a smile at all times, greet guests, member and fellow employees when encountered, show appreciation to the guests and the members, and demonstrate a willingness to help guests and members at all times.
  11. Possesses and understanding of the importance of safety and sees that safe operation procedures are observed in all daily activities. Adheres to the safety program.
  12. Demonstrates a commitment to the work and success of the club and the Company by being service- and solution-oriented, having positive interactions with all club staff and members/guests, and meeting established quality, service and safety expectations.
  13. Performs additional assignments per the direction of club or Company managers.
  14. Regular and punctual attendance on site for all scheduled shifts is required.

WORK HOURS AND CONDITIONS

Work hours may include early mornings and evenings on weekdays, weekends and holidays. Subject to inside and outside environmental conditions. May be exposed to inclement (non-threatening) weather, plant protection products, fertilizers, misdirected golf balls, and sharp and rapid equipment movement on a daily basis. Injury may result as a result of exposure to the above if safety policies and practices are not properly followed.

title: PMO & Transformation Lead
description:
The Transformation Program Manager leads and coordinates strategic initiatives and cross-functional workstreams across Smiths Detection Inc. (SDI). The role establishes consistent program and project governance, provides transparency into progress and performance, manages risks and interdependencies, and ensures that enterprise initiatives remain aligned with SDI’s strategic and financial priorities.

Working closely with executive sponsors, functional leaders and workstream owners, the position converts strategic objectives into structured execution plans with clearly defined scope, milestones, resources, accountabilities, performance measures and expected business benefits.

The role serves as the central point of coordination for designated SDI programs and other strategic initiatives requiring collaboration across multiple functions. The position may directly manage priority projects while also providing governance, tools, coaching and oversight to functional project and workstream leaders.

Essential functions

  • Establish and maintain an enterprise program management framework for designated SDI strategic initiatives and transformation programs.
  • Translate strategic priorities into integrated program plans, including scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, dependencies, performance measures and expected business outcomes.
  • Coordinate cross-functional workstreams involving Operations, Programs, Service, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Sales, Commercial, Engineering, Quality, IT and other applicable functions.
  • Partner with executive sponsors and functional leaders to establish workstream ownership, decision rights, governance forums and escalation protocols.
  • Manage the portfolio of designated enterprise initiatives, including project intake, evaluation, prioritization, sequencing and resource-capacity considerations.
  • Develop and maintain integrated program roadmaps showing major milestones, cross-functional dependencies, critical paths and implementation timing.
  • Provide timely and accurate reporting to the SDI Leadership Team on program status, achievements, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions required and expected business impact.
  • Identify risks, resource constraints and competing priorities that could affect execution; facilitate resolution and escalate material issues when necessary.
  • Facilitate executive steering committee meetings, workstream reviews, planning sessions and decision-making forums.
  • Ensure decisions, action items, owners and due dates are documented, communicated and monitored through completion.
  • Develop standardized program-management tools, templates, reporting practices and governance standards that can be used across SDI.
  • Provide project-management guidance, coaching and support to functional project leaders and workstream owners.
  • Lead or coordinate organizational change-management activities, including stakeholder analysis, change-impact assessments, communications, training readiness and adoption planning.
  • Partner with Finance and business leaders to define expected benefits, establish performance baselines and monitor financial and operational benefits realization.
  • Evaluate program performance against approved business cases, timelines, budgets, resource plans and success measures.
  • Recommend the initiation, reprioritization, acceleration, pause or termination of projects based on strategic alignment, business value, execution risk and organizational capacity.
  • Directly manage selected high-priority projects or workstreams when centralized ownership is required.
  • Promote collaboration, accountability, transparency and disciplined execution across functional and organizational boundaries.

Education Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, project management, engineering, finance, operations, organizational change or a related discipline required

Years of Experience:

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in program management, project management, business transformation, strategy execution or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in management consulting, private equity, investment banking, corporate strategy, or enterprise transformation, with demonstrated experience supporting complex, cross-functional initiative

Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong enterprise program-management, portfolio-management and governance capabilities.
  • Ability to translate strategic objectives into practical execution plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence, align and hold stakeholders accountable without relying on direct authority.
  • Strong facilitation, negotiation, conflict-resolution and decision-support skills.
  • Ability to identify and manage risks, issues, dependencies and resource constraints across multiple workstreams.
  • Strong financial and business acumen, including experience with business cases, budgets, cost-benefit analysis and benefits realization.
  • Working knowledge of organizational change-management principles and adoption practices.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive-level reporting.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint and project or portfolio-management tools; experience with Power BI is preferred.
  • Experience with enterprise business systems, such as ERP, CRM, HRIS or similar platforms, is preferred.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed environment while managing multiple strategic priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to maintain composure, exercise sound judgment and lead effectively in high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential business information appropriately

We offer…

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. You’ll experience an inclusive environment, with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. You’ll also have the flexibility to choose from a wide range of benefits to suit your lifestyle, offering you and your family support from a health and wellbeing, financial and lifestyle perspective.

Join us and work for a world-leader, with the benefits and training to reward your dedication and skills. Be part of a team where we are making the world a safer place.

title: Monitoring & Observability Engineer
description:
At OQC, we aren’t just theorising about the future; we’re building it. Born from a philosophy of bold innovation, we’ve successfully transitioned quantum computing from an academic dream into a commercial reality. The most exciting thing is that we’re just getting started and we’ve recently closed our £260 million Series C funding round – the largest fundraise ever completed by a quantum computing company in Europe.

The Purpose

As a Monitoring and Observability Engineer, you'll help keep OQC's live quantum computing systems running at their best. By improving system visibility, developing intelligent monitoring solutions and driving operational improvements, you'll play a key role in maximising uptime and enabling world-class live quantum computing services.

The Role

Working within our Live Services team, you'll monitor the health and performance of our live cryogenic systems, respond to operational incidents and continuously improve our observability capabilities. You'll collaborate across engineering, operations, software and reliability teams to develop dashboards, refine alerting strategies and automate operational responses that improve reliability and reduce downtime.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Monitor live systems, triage operational alerts and provide first-line incident response to maximise system availability.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards that deliver clear visibility into system health, trends and operational performance.
  • Analyse recurring incidents and monitoring data to identify root causes, improve alert quality and drive preventative action.
  • Collaborate with Reliability Engineering, Software and Operations teams to enhance observability tooling and operational processes.
  • Define monitoring thresholds, alerting strategies and operational metrics that support reliable live quantum computing services.
  • Produce documentation covering monitoring processes, incident response, escalation procedures and operational handovers.
  • Contribute to automation and continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual intervention and improve service reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience working in monitoring, observability or operational support for complex technical systems.
  • Experience working with dashboards, telemetry, alarms, logs or time-series data.
  • Experience supporting uptime, incident response or on-call operational environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, anomalies and operational risks.
  • Experience developing software in Python using modern development practices.
  • Experience creating and maintaining operational dashboards.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams.
  • Degree, HNC/HND, apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Controls, Instrumentation, Data or a related technical discipline.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and travel internationally when required.

The 'Nice-to-Haves'

  • Experience with Grafana Labs or similar observability platforms.
  • Experience monitoring high-availability technical systems.
  • Understanding of incident management, root cause analysis, reliability engineering or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles.
  • Experience with HTTP/REST APIs, Git, containerisation, Kubernetes or Infrastructure as Code.
  • Continuous improvement, ownership or leadership experience.

Why Join OQC

You will join a world-class team at the forefront of the next computational era. We offer a culture of bold innovation, the chance to work with unique lab infrastructure, and the opportunity to see your work redefine the limits of computation.

title: Project Manager
description:
Overview:

Vivi is the only wireless screen mirroring and digital signage tool designed for education. We help IT help teachers help students with classroom technology that enhances collaboration, control, and creativity.


Vivi exists because we all had that one teacher who changed our life, who went above and beyond to serve as a role model and sage. They guided discussion, connected with their students on a personal level, were just as engaging and entertaining as they were educational, and they created a dynamic learning environment by constantly involving students.


Personalised learning environments have been proven to deliver better educational outcomes for individuals through increased participation and engagement. To successfully create such an environment requires a fluid, visual dialogue between teacher and student. This is why Vivi exists. Vivi is used by over 825,000 teachers and students around the world and is setting out to provide tangible solutions to the enormous education industry with our high-growth, ambitious, and creative team. In this rapidly evolving technology landscape, Vivi is always looking for new ways to disrupt the classroom experience, enhance customer journeys, and expand globally.


The Role

As Project Manager, you will own the delivery of a portfolio of projects that spans the entire business – from product and engineering through sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and support. This is a truly cross-functional role: you will take projects from inception to release and through the post launch period, bringing structure, momentum, and visibility to initiatives that no single department owns. Reporting to the CFO within the Finance and Operations team, you will plan, estimate, coordinate, and communicate relentlessly – and when things stall, you will hustle to get results. While this is not a technical project management role, Vivi is a technology business, so you will bring a working understanding of software, agile ways of working, and how product and engineering teams deliver. And while the role is not exclusively about AI, Vivi is undergoing an AI transformation – both in how the business operates and in its products, through its Vivi Classroom Intelligence initiatives – and many of the projects in your portfolio will be part of that change. Your immediate priority, and the first mission of this role, is to project-manage the delivery of Vivi’s new product launch from end to end – building and driving the plan that brings it to market, working to the Product Manager who owns the overall launch. Once it has successfully landed, you will take on the broader portfolio described here.


Responsibilities:

Portfolio & Project Delivery:

  • Manage a portfolio of concurrent projects across the business, from inception through to go-live and through post-launch stabilisation, ensuring each has clear objectives, scope, owners, and success measures.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource estimates, tracking progress and keeping delivery on course.
  • Apply the right level of governance to each initiative – kick-offs, status reporting, steering updates, and post-project reviews – bringing structure without drowning teams in process.
  • Manage dependencies between departments, understanding the critical path and sequencing work so the whole portfolio keeps moving.
  • For product releases, build and drive the end-to-end launch plan – spanning delivery, go-to-market readiness and the post-launch period coordinating every function required (sales, marketing, product, engineering, IT, operations, customer success, support, finance, legal and security) to reach go-live and beyond. The Product Manager owns the overall product launch; this role owns the plan and its execution.
  • For product releases, coordinate the required data-privacy and security sign-offs – including student-data obligations and ST4S – so they are obtained before go-live.
  • Coordinate the post-implementation review (PIR) process across all major projects and product launches – capturing outcomes, benefits realised and lessons learned, and feeding them back to improve how Vivi delivers.

Planning & Estimation:

  • Facilitate planning and estimation with project teams, turning ambiguous goals into achievable, resourced plans.
  • Build realistic estimates with the people doing the work, track actuals against them, and improve forecast accuracy over time.
  • Identify, assess, and actively manage risks, issues, and assumptions – escalating early, with options rather than just problems.

Stakeholder Management & Communication:

  • Communicate clearly and constantly – the right information, at the right level, at the right time – from working teams through to executive stakeholders.
  • Build strong relationships across Product and Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Finance, becoming the trusted connector who knows what is happening across the business.
  • Facilitate decision-making: frame the options, gather input, drive to a decision, record it, and move on.

Reporting & Insights:

  • Own the portfolio reporting rhythm: produce high-quality, accurate reports on a regular, dependable cadence, so leadership always knows the state of play.
  • Present portfolio and project reports to the executive and leadership teams, confidently answering questions on status, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
  • Ensure reporting is built on reliable data – a single source of truth for status, budgets, and forecasts – so decisions are made on facts, not impressions.

Execution & Drive:

  • Create momentum: chase actions, unblock teams, and keep initiatives moving between meetings, not just during them.
  • Roll up your sleeves – when a project needs something done that has no owner, own it.
  • Balance persistence with pragmatism, knowing when to push, when to escalate, and when to re-plan.
  • Continuously improve how Vivi delivers projects, capturing lessons learned and building lightweight, repeatable ways of working.


Experience:

  • Solid project management experience (approximately 5+ years) with a proven record of delivering cross-functional projects end to end (essential).
  • Demonstrated experience delivering cross-business product launches or go-to-market programmes end to end – knowing how to coordinate across sales, marketing, product, engineering, IT, operations, finance and legal to bring a product to market – not just running internal IT or technical projects (essential).
  • Experience building or establishing a project management function, process or framework is highly valued we do not have a set process today, so a builder who can bring structure while managing and coordinating stakeholders well will add real value.
  • Experience working in a technology or software business, with a good understanding of agile ways of working and how product and engineering teams deliver (essential).
  • A basic, practical understanding of technology – enough to hold your own in delivery conversations; this is not a technical project management role.
  • Strong planning, scheduling, and estimation skills across projects of varying size and complexity.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate at all levels from engineers to executives.
  • Experience producing accurate, executive quality reporting to a regular cadence, and presenting it to executive and leadership audiences (essential).
  • Highly organised, with experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
  • Proficiency with project and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence, or similar.
  • Commercial awareness, with comfort managing project budgets and reporting into a finance function (desirable).
  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or an agile certification (desirable, not required).
  • Experience in the EdTech industry (advantageous).
  • Exposure to AI initiatives, or delivering business or product transformation programs (advantageous).
  • A results-driven self-starter with the energy and persistence to get things over the line.

title: Senior Java & Angular Engineer
description:

title: Head of Technical Services (UK)
description:
Head of Technical Services

At OQC, we aren’t just theorising about the future; we’re building it. Born from a philosophy of bold innovation, we’ve successfully transitioned quantum computing from an academic dream into a commercial reality. The most exciting thing is that we’re just getting started and we’ve recently closed our £260 million Series C funding round – the largest fundraise ever completed by a quantum computing company in Europe.

The Purpose

As Head of Technical Services, you'll lead the teams and technical environments that enable OQC's engineers and scientists to build, test and deploy quantum computers. From cryogenic laboratories and assembly workshops to machining facilities and international deployments, you'll ensure our technical operations have the people, infrastructure and operational discipline needed to deliver at scale.

The Role

Leading our Technical Services function within Engineering Operations, you'll have accountability for a team of technicians, machinists and supervisors, alongside the safe and effective operation of OQC's UK technical spaces. You'll combine people leadership with operational, commercial and project ownership—managing suppliers, budgets and improvement programmes while ensuring our technical capabilities keep pace with OQC's ambitions.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Lead, develop and motivate our Technical Services team, including technicians, machinists and supervisors, creating clear accountability for delivery.
  • Own the safe, reliable and effective operation of OQC's UK technical spaces, including cryogenic laboratories, assembly workshops and machining facilities.
  • Oversee maintenance schedules, internal work orders and operational performance, using clear reporting and metrics to drive delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Own relationships with external suppliers, assessing value for money and partnering with Supply Chain, Purchasing and Legal to establish effective contracts and services.
  • Lead cross-functional projects and improvement initiatives, bringing teams together to resolve operational challenges and deliver change.
  • Manage technical space expenditure, longer-term budget forecasts and delivery timelines, providing clear reporting to senior stakeholders.
  • Execute agreed Engineering Operations roadmap priorities, aligning stakeholders around milestones and ensuring accountability through to delivery.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading engineering or operational teams within a manufacturing, engineering or scientific environment.
  • Proven project leadership experience within complex technical or operational environments.
  • Experience managing external partners and assessing supplier performance and value for money.
  • Strong operational reporting and presentation capability, including communicating effectively with senior leaders, customers and technical teams.
  • Strong budgetary control, project forecasting and delivery management skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder, supplier and relationship management capability, with the confidence to influence across organisational boundaries.
  • A pragmatic leadership style—you can turn complex objectives into clear priorities, motivate teams and escalate issues early with well-considered solutions.
  • Degree or equivalent experience in an Engineering or Manufacturing discipline.

The 'Nice-to-Haves'

  • Experience forecasting and managing significant annual operational budgets, particularly in the region of £2m–£6m.
  • Experience applying Lean management and risk management methodologies.
  • Strong negotiation and mediation skills.
  • Leadership qualification or training.
  • Health & Safety qualification or training.

Why Join OQC

You will join a world-class team at the forefront of the next computational era. We offer a culture of bold innovation, the chance to work with unique lab infrastructure, and the opportunity to see your work redefine the limits of computation.

title: EHS Safety Professional
description:
The Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Professional reviews, evaluates, and analyzes work environments and is responsible for designing policies and procedures to ensure adherence to regulations on safety, health, and the environment. They also design programs to prevent disease or injury to workers and damage to the environment. The incumbent analyzes regulatory required compliance and technical issues, and communicates those analyses with clients, peers, and with regulatory agencies when needed.

The essential functions/duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete list, and other duties will be assigned based on the incumbent’s role within EHS programs and changing needs of the employer.

1. Participates in achieving the goals of the safety organization.

2. Plans, implements and coordinates safety programs and procedures.

3. Keeps current with any changes in regulations and implements changes accordingly. Ensures manuals, policies and procedures are in place and clarifies intent to support adherence to regulations and company expectations.

4. Collaborates with other facility/site safety staff to support consistency and knowledge sharing across all sites as appropriate.

5. Supports and mentors the development of technical safety skills for employees and leaders in the facility.

6. Executes the safety vision and plan for the facility and mentors the staff in achieving that vision.

7. Conducts or coordinates employee training in areas of safety, regulations, hazardous condition monitoring, and use of safety equipment.

8. Maintains training matrix for site specific required training.

9. Investigates incidents (near hit, injury) including:

a. Follows notification protocol internal to EC and EHS for each specific site.

b. Aids in initial care and follow up care with injured employees and case management.

c. Investigates incidents.

d. Ensures incident report has been completed by and distributed to the appropriate parties within established timelines.

10. Leads and documents appropriate risk/hazard assessments. Conducts corresponding follow-ups and implementation of corrective action items to support minimization and/or elimination of incidents that have the potential to cause harm to one of EHS's employees, contractors, or visitors.

11. Ergonomic Initiative Focus: Focuses on work that takes employees out of the neutral zone, creating body positioning issues, which may increase risk of musculoskeletal disorders.

12. Upon award of a new project, collaborates with the project team in developing the

Environmental Health and Safety plan (EHSP) for the project. Additionally, perform walks with supervision to become familiar with the upcoming scope of work and to identify potential issues (hazards, impacts) that need to be mitigated.

13. Effectively communicates the health and safety goals, objectives, performance expectations, and metrics to employees at each work site.

14. Consults with and provides support/guidance to employees regarding both personal medical and work-related injuries to identify opportunities for improved safety performance, risk reduction and cost reduction.

15. Performs and administers safety audits including inspection of safety facilities, machinery, and safety equipment to identify and correct potential hazards, and to ensure safety regulation compliance.

16. Performs regular (weekly) audit recaps and distributes as directed by supervisor.

17. Oversees facility safety inventory including supplies, equipment and training materials.

18. Analyzes and utilizes data to set safety priorities and develop action plans.

19. Responds as intermediary in situations involving team member safety and site safety.

20. Participates in pre-task plan/job briefing reviews.

21. Represents EC to work with the GC/Client/Owner EHS professionals to provide guidance and council overall project safety.

22. Site specific EHS professionals will also follow the EHS Internal Roles of site EHS guidelines and work with the project teams to detail any specific needs.

Requirements

  • Bachelors (BA/BS) degree in Safety Management, Industrial Hygiene, or related subject from an accredited school; or
  • Associates (AA/AS) degree in Safety Management, Industrial Hygiene, or related subject from an accredited school; and at least two or more years related experience and/or training in professional safety in the field; or
  • Successful completion of an accredited EHS Apprentice program.

Any equivalent combination of education and experience which provides the knowledge, skills and abilities to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position will be considered.

  • Possession of or ability to obtain and maintain a valid Oregon driver license.
  • OSHA 30 in construction required or equivalent certification.
  • Current First Aid, CPR and AED certification preferred.
  • Board of Certified Safety Professionals (BCSP) or Institute of Hazardous Materials Management (IHMM)
  • Frequent Travel for project visits is required, typically 40% to 60%, with some overnight travel as needed.

Benefits

Compensation and Benefits:

Salary range for this position is $85,000-$105,000 annually.

Opportunity for a discretionary year-end bonus.

401k with a 40% employer match (up to federal limit.)

Please find more information on our compensation package here.

title: Associate Product Manager - 1477
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Associate Product Manager to support the growth and development of a specialized healthcare and medical device product portfolio.

The Associate Product Manager will support product strategy, product marketing, market research, product launches, competitive analysis, and product lifecycle management. This position will use market data, customer insights, and business analytics to develop recommendations that support revenue growth, customer adoption, and overall product performance.

The role will collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, Product Development, Operations, Clinical, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to develop and execute product strategies and successful go-to-market initiatives.

The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially minded, organized, and comfortable working with both internal teams and external healthcare customers.

Travel: Approximately 20–30% domestic travel may be required.

Key Responsibilities

Market Research & Analysis

  • Research and analyze market trends, customer needs, competitive activity, industry developments, and clinical information.
  • Identify market opportunities and recommend strategies for product growth and development.
  • Conduct competitive analysis to understand market positioning and opportunities.
  • Collect and analyze Voice of Customer (VOC) feedback to identify product challenges and opportunities.
  • Support market research initiatives related to new products, product enhancements, and positioning.
  • Prepare recurring dashboards and reports covering key product and business metrics.
  • Translate market and sales data into actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Monitor market penetration, customer adoption, product performance, and growth opportunities.

Product Planning & Management

  • Support the management of assigned healthcare and medical device product lines throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Serve as a product and market resource for assigned product categories and competitive offerings.
  • Develop and manage project timelines for new product development and product launches.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Finance to support pricing strategy and forecasting.
  • Work with Product Development, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations teams on product planning and commercialization.
  • Coordinate the development of product-related marketing and sales materials.
  • Manage cross-functional projects, timelines, priorities, and deliverables.
  • Support customer research and product feedback initiatives.
  • Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for optimization, growth, and cost improvement.
  • Assist with product lifecycle management, including product enhancements, positioning, and portfolio planning.
  • Support leadership with go-to-market strategy, sales forecasting, business planning, and product strategy.
  • Assist with developing product value propositions, positioning, messaging, and launch strategies.
  • Collaborate with Customer Service and Operations to address specialized customer and product requirements.

Product Marketing

  • Develop and support product marketing plans and campaigns designed to increase product awareness, adoption, and demand.
  • Partner with Marketing Communications, Sales Training, Clinical Education, and Creative teams to develop sales tools and educational materials.
  • Develop and deliver product training and presentations for sales teams and other internal audiences.
  • Participate in customer meetings, field visits, product demonstrations, and healthcare presentations.
  • Build and maintain relationships with customers, clinicians, healthcare professionals, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Support trade shows, conferences, educational events, customer meetings, and industry programs.
  • Assist with identifying key customers, industry experts, and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) who can support product adoption.
  • Ensure consistent product messaging across marketing, sales, educational, and customer-facing materials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Marketing, Product Development, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and Customer Service teams.
  • Communicate project status, business insights, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to leadership.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple teams to ensure successful product development and commercialization.
  • Maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to business communications and requests.

Compliance & Quality

  • Follow applicable company policies, procedures, quality requirements, and healthcare and medical device regulations.
  • Support compliance with applicable FDA, ISO, and industry requirements.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and records.
  • Follow established procedures and work instructions.
  • Ensure product marketing and commercialization activities meet applicable regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related field required.
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 2–3 years of experience in product management, product marketing, brand management, marketing, or a related business function.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting product launches and commercialization.
  • Strong project management and timeline development skills.
  • Experience with financial analysis, forecasting, pricing, or business modeling.
  • Strong customer-facing and presentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical, clinical, commercial, and non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, medical devices, clinical products, or regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with FDA and ISO requirements.
  • Understanding of clinical, healthcare, or reimbursement environments.
  • Experience with CRM systems and market analytics.
  • Experience conducting market research and competitive analysis.
  • Experience developing product training, clinical education, or sales enablement materials.
  • Experience working with cross-functional product development teams.

Physical & Work Environment

  • This position may operate in an office, operational, manufacturing, customer, and/or healthcare environment.
  • Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, use hands, reach, communicate, bend, and occasionally lift or move light materials.
  • May occasionally be required to lift items weighing less than 25 pounds.
  • Ability to travel domestically as required.

title: Public Financial Management (PFM) and Budget Advocacy Specialist -- Consultant
description:
23rd of September, 2026 WISH2 (Women’s Integrated Sexual Health 2) aims to increase access to quality integrated and inclusive FP/SRH services among marginalized and hard to reach populations including young people and adolescents, people living with disabilities and those in humanitarian contexts. WISH2 is one of three components of the overarching WISH Dividend programme that is being procured by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth, and Development Office (FCDO). IPPF is the prime contractor on Lot 2 – Eastern and Southern Africa (ESA) covering the following countries: Burundi, Ethiopia, Madagascar, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, and Zambia.

This role sits within output 3 of the programme, which aims to strengthen the enabling environment for SRHR by supporting countries to adopt and implement improved policy frameworks for SRHR, increased and more efficient domestic investment and more robust systems of accountability. In the context of increased threats to SRH rights, this output has an increasing focus on safeguarding the gains made by monitoring and countering the rollback of rights.

The consultant will provide demand-led technical support to the WISH2 programme, with a focus on increasing the quantity and efficiency of domestic investment in sexual and reproductive health (SRH) through support to public financial management and politically informed, civil society led advocacy.

Scope of Work
In consultation with the Regional Lead, Health Systems and Financing and other WISH2 regional staff, the consultant will:
  • Provide strategic input and technical support to ensure WISH2 delivers against or exceeds FCDO’s expectations in relation to health financing, with a focus on increasing the quantity and efficiency of domestic investment in SRH/FP in line with national commitments.
  • Provide technical support and skills development to local actors in WISH2 ESA countries to address bottlenecks in the public financial management (PFM) system and support politically informed, data-driven advocacy to increase investment in FP/SRH.
  • Support Health Financing Advisors in WISH2 ESA countries to implement a locally-led approach to strengthening health systems and sustainable financing, including through support to the development of milestones that contribute to tangible results along the WISH2 Pathway of Change in alignment with the Country Policy Overview and Engagement Plans (CPOEPs) and the programme Logframe.
  • Contribute to documentation of results and the publication and dissemination of research and programmatic learning.
Tools and approaches
The consultant will adapt and apply the tools and approaches developed through the WISH2 programme in order to achieve programmatic goals. Examples of tools include the Public Financial Management (PFM) self-assessment and scorecard; the Budget Monitoring and Tracking (BMT) and the SMART advocacy training materials. Each of these tools will be adapted and contextualized to the specific country in consultation with WISH2 staff and other national stakeholders.

Contracting approach
The contractual model is a draw-down contract, whereby each specific assignment will be agreed in advance with the contract manager (Regional Lead, Health Systems and Financing, WISH2). For each new task/assignment, a new work order will be prepared. The total number of days will not exceed 60 days over the 12-month duration of the framework contract.

Both parties will discuss and agree on the details for each assignment, including the necessary timeframes and deadlines. This will be defined in writing via a Work Order.

At the point of each work order, deliverables will be determined and agreed. The Work Order will describe payment and approval mechanisms as well as the outputs required for the assignment. Expertise & skills:
  • Bachelor’s degree in economics, public health, health economics, health management or related field.
  • Technical specialism in Health Systems Strengthening and Health Financing, ideally with a focus on domestic resource mobilisation, public financial management, political economy analysis and health budget advocacy
  • Demonstrated ability to provide high quality, demand-driven technical assistance to national stakeholders including national and local governments, civil society organisations and other local institutions in Sub-Saharan Africa
  • Expertise in systems thinking, and the development and application of tools and approaches to diagnose health systems bottlenecks and facilitative collaborative action planning and prioritization.
  • At least five years’ experience in working with national stakeholders and institutions to develop strong relationships and to build skills and competencies e.g. in health financing concepts or budget analysis
  • In depth understanding of Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights and Family Planning (SRHR/FP) in developing countries
  • Proven ability to successfully manage and provide backstopping support to individuals and teams in remote settings through in-person and virtual engagement
  • Ability to analyse, interpret and present data (eg government budgets) so that it is easily understood by non-experts
  • Excellent skills in written and verbal communication
  • Demonstrated interpersonal skills that enables effective team building and problem solving.
  • Proficiency in French and English essential
Application Process
Please send your application (CV and cover letter) detailing your experience and why you are best suited to the consultancy to ippfarbids@ippf.org with the subject heading “Public Financial Management (PFM) and Budget Advocacy Specialist”
• Deadline for application is 23rd September 2026

Technical and financial proposals as well as the supporting documents should be separate documents (the 2 proposals and zipped documents of the supporting documents) where necessary. Only proposals meeting all mandatory requirements will be considered for evaluation.

description:

Humanity & Inclusion / Handicap International - co-recipient of the Nobel Peace Prize, is an independent and impartial organisation working in situations of poverty and exclusion, conflict and disaster. Through our actions on the ground and our advocacy, we respond to the essential needs of vulnerable populations, improve their living conditions and promote respect for their dignity and fundamental rights. HI is present in 56 countries around the world.

Please let us know if you needed any special fittings, even during the first consultation.

CONTEXTE: In order to implement its development and humanitarian activities in its countries of interventions, HI mobilizes funding from a large range of institutional partners.
As an Institutional Funding Trainee, you will join the Institutional Funding North Europe team (FINE) at Humanity & Inclusion (HI) office in Brussels. This team mobilizes funding from a portfolio of donors’ accounts that includes the EU (mainly ECHO, INTPA, EEAS, MENA, ENEST and FPI), the Nordic countries (Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark) and the Benelux countries (Belgium, Luxembourg, The Netherlands).
You will work under the supervision of the Head of FINE and in close collaboration with the other members of the FINE team, Institutional Partnership Officers and Senior Officers.   • Monitor the publication of calls for proposals and other funding opportunities (mainly Belgian donors) and investigate specific donor guidance such as thematic policies, etc.
    Support lessons learning exercises

  • Carry out an analysis on the localization trend and its effect on the North Europe & UE donors
  • Carry out a mapping of the topics/ actors/ influence circles of Handicap International (for example in Belgium)
  • Compare & analyse the EU calls with HI’s sectors
  • Present these analyses to relevant HI’s operational and technical staff.
  • Carry out any other relevant analysis depending on the candidate’s interests and on the team’s needs.

Task 3: Support the management of information and communication materials

  • In coordination with the respective team members, ensure the harmonization of the FINE donors’ space on HInside (collaborative intranet network for sharing information within HI).
  • Update CRM internal intelligence tool
  • Feed relevant information in a user-friendly way to the above-mentioned space upon request.
  • Create and update internal donor reference documents upon request
  • Provide administrative support (official letters, copies of reports, emails, etc.)
  • Ensure rigorous filing and verification of electronic archive folders

Task 4: Support the building and strengthening of training materials and webinars

  • Review training materials (e.g. PowerPoint presentations)
  • Contribute to the preparation of webinars

Requirements

  • You are currently studying for a Master in the field of international cooperation, humanitarian affairs, social sciences (or any other relevant field) ;
  • You have some prior experience of volunteering with an international organization with multiple stakeholders ;
  • You are Proficient user of Microsoft Office Package and communication tools ;
  • You are fluent in English and French (written and spoken);
  • Fluency in Dutch is desirable, and fluency in Spanish would be an advantage;
  • You have excellent summarising, analytical and writing skills;
  • You are Dynamic, self-organized and detail-oriented,
  • You are comfortable with the idea of working in a multicultural environment;
  • You have an interest in humanitarian work and international cooperation, as well as in HI’s mission.

Benefits

  • Type of contract: CIP/Internship agreement with a school
  • Working environment: HI office in Brussels

TO APPLY:

Applications must be submitted by email only, accompanied by a CV and a covering letter, to the following address: y.claeys@hi.org

Applications are processed on an ongoing basis, so don’t delay in applying!

Only candidates shortlisted for further consideration will be contacted; thank you for your understanding.

title: Senior Quantum Engineer - QSER
description:
Senior Quantum Engineer - QSER

At OQC, we aren’t just theorising about the future; we’re building it. Born from a philosophy of bold innovation, we’ve successfully transitioned quantum computing from an academic dream into a commercial reality. The most exciting thing is that we’re just getting started.

The Purpose

Lead scientific research that advances OQC’s quantum processors, superconducting circuit technology and supporting infrastructure.

As a Senior Quantum Engineer, you’ll own complex research projects across the full scientific lifecycle—from identifying research priorities and designing experiments through to implementation, data analysis and final recommendations. Your work will directly influence OQC’s technology roadmap and the performance of future quantum processing units.

The Role

You’ll be a senior member of our Quantum Science & Exploratory Research team, combining hands-on experimental research with technical leadership, project ownership and mentoring.

Working across superconducting quantum circuits, processor characterisation, calibration, benchmarking and cryogenic measurement systems, you’ll investigate the limitations of existing technologies and explore new approaches to qubit design, packaging and quantum-processing infrastructure.

You’ll also help shape the QSER roadmap, coordinate the resources required to deliver experimental programmes and support the development of Quantum Engineers across the team.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Lead complex scientific research projects from initial concept and experimental design through to implementation, analysis, reporting and technical recommendations.
  • Design, simulate and characterise novel superconducting components for quantum processors and their supporting infrastructure.
  • Measure, calibrate and benchmark superconducting quantum circuits, developing performance metrics and investigating QPU design or processor limitations.
  • Lead investigations into alternative qubit architectures and packaging approaches, translating experimental evidence into recommendations for future development.
  • Coordinate the scheduling and resourcing of quantum-processing infrastructure, including multiple cryogenic systems, control electronics and measurement equipment.
  • Shape the QSER technology roadmap by reporting progress, assessing the feasibility of milestones and recommending future scientific priorities.
  • Mentor Quantum Engineers, maintain high-quality project documentation and represent OQC through conferences, research collaborations and scientific publications.

What We’re Looking For

  • A degree in physics, quantum engineering, electrical engineering or another relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience owning research projects involving the measurement, characterisation or operation of quantum systems.
  • Hands-on experience running experimental quantum-computing measurements, benchmarking processes or operational methods within an academic or industrial environment.
  • Experience creating or running simulations of the quantum or radio-frequency properties of superconducting circuits.
  • Strong scientific software-development skills, particularly Python or a comparable language, for experimental automation and data analysis.
  • The ability to analyse complex datasets, develop meaningful performance metrics and translate results into clear technical recommendations.
  • Strong project leadership or project-management skills, including an understanding of resource, scheduling and budget implications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distil complex scientific information for different technical audiences.
  • A creative and evidence-led approach to problem-solving, combined with sound scientific judgement and strong planning skills.
  • The ability to influence technical direction, delegate effectively and support the development of less-experienced engineers.

The ‘Nice-to-Haves’

  • A PhD in physics, quantum engineering, electrical engineering or a closely related field.
  • Experience using or developing microwave-frequency control hardware for superconducting quantum systems.
  • Scientific publication experience, particularly within superconducting circuits, quantum measurement or related fields.
  • Experience presenting research findings at conferences, technical reviews or collaborative research forums.
  • Hands-on experience preparing, handling and installing samples within cryogenic enclosures.
  • Knowledge of the specification, installation and maintenance of RF or DC wiring.
  • Experience operating and maintaining cryogenic refrigeration and vacuum systems.
  • Experience developing remote-operation or automation methods for low-noise measurements.

Why Join OQC

You’ll join a multidisciplinary team working at the forefront of superconducting quantum computing, with the opportunity to take genuine ownership of research that informs both near-term engineering decisions and OQC’s longer-term technology direction.

This is an opportunity to combine deep scientific work with visible technical leadership—investigating novel quantum technologies, working directly with advanced cryogenic and measurement infrastructure, and helping develop the people and research capabilities behind OQC’s next generation of quantum processors.

title: Principal, Enterprise Data Strategy, AI & Analytics, Amazon Leo
description:
We are seeking a principal-level (L7) leader to own and drive the Enterprise Data Strategy, AI, and
New Datamart vision across our ERP-centric technology landscape. This role spans enterprise
platforms including SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud Applications and similar ERP ecosystems leveraging
modern data platforms such as SAP Datasphere, Oracle Analytics Cloud, Databricks, Amazon
Redshift, or equivalent to build a unified, intelligent data fabric.
This leader will serve as the strategic bridge between enterprise data architecture, advanced
analytics, and business intelligence — translating complex, multi-Enterprise application data
landscapes into actionable, AI-powered insights at scale. The ideal candidate is platform-fluent but
platform-agnostic, able to design data strategies that harness the best of any enterprise application
ecosystem while maintaining a clean, governed, and extensible data foundation.
A critical mandate of this role is to establish and chair a Data Governance Council within
Manufacturing Operations, driving cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing,
Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure data integrity, standardization, and actionable intelligence
throughout the manufacturing value chain.

Key job responsibilities
Enterprise Data Strategy & Datamart Architecture
• Define and own the enterprise data strategy across ERP-centric environments (SAP, Oracle,
or similar), establishing the roadmap for modernizing legacy data warehouses into cloud-
native datamarts.
• Design and implement a new Datamart architecture leveraging platforms such as SAP
Datasphere, Amazon Redshift, Aurora, unifying ERP and non-ERP data through virtualization,
replication, or hybrid approaches.
• Establish the semantic layer and business data fabric that preserves business context across
disparate enterprise systems, enabling consistent metrics, KPIs, and definitions across all
functional domains (Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, Order-to-Cash,
Procurement).
• Lead Data Modeling & Semantic Layer design — defining reusable business terms, metrics,
relationships, and associations that support analytics, planning, and AI/ML initiatives
regardless of the underlying ERP platform.
• Architect cloud data warehousing, data marts, and data pipelines & orchestration to
ensure scalable, performant, and governed data delivery from multiple ERP sources.

Own Data Quality & Governance frameworks ensuring data integrity, lineage, certification,
and lifecycle management across all enterprise datamarts and ERP systems — with
particular emphasis on Manufacturing Operations data standards.
Manufacturing Operations Data Governance Council
This role is accountable for chartering, establishing, and chairing a Data Governance Council within
Manufacturing Operations. The council will drive cross-functional data alignment and decision-
making across key operational domains:
• Charter and launch the Manufacturing Operations Data Governance Council, defining its
mission, scope, membership, decision rights, escalation paths, and cadence of reviews.
• Collaborate with Engineering to standardize product data definitions, BOM structures,
engineering change order data flows, and design-to-manufacturing data handoffs.
• Partner with Manufacturing to govern production data (MES, quality, yield, OEE), enforce
data standards across shop-floor systems, and enable real-time manufacturing analytics.
• Align with Supply Chain on demand planning data, inventory master data, logistics and
fulfillment metrics, and end-to-end supply chain visibility through governed data pipelines.
• Coordinate with Finance to ensure manufacturing cost data, variance analysis, standard
costing, and COGS reporting are underpinned by trusted, governed data from operational
systems.
• Define and enforce cross-functional data standards, data ownership models, stewardship
roles, and data quality SLAs across all council-participating functions.
• Establish a data issue resolution framework with clear escalation paths and accountability,
ensuring disputes over data definitions, ownership, and quality are resolved efficiently.
• Report governance health metrics to senior leadership, including data quality scorecards,
policy compliance rates, and council effectiveness KPIs.
Enterprise Reporting & Analytics
• Set the strategic direction for ERP-native reporting capabilities — including SAP Embedded
Analytics (Fiori), Oracle OTBI/BI Publisher, or equivalent built-in reporting tools.
• Drive the evolution of Enterprise Analytics & BI leveraging platforms such as SAP Analytics
Cloud (SAC), Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), Amazon QuickSight, Tableau, or Power BI for
dashboards, scorecards, planning, predictive analytics, and self-service analytics.
• Define and implement KPI Frameworks and Data Visualization standards, enabling insight-
to-action workflows across the enterprise independent of the source ERP system.
• Champion User Enablement & Adoption designing programs that democratize data access
and empower business users with self-service analytics capabilities across all ERP platforms.
• Standardize operational reporting, ad-hoc reporting, and embedded analytics patterns that
work consistently whether the source system is SAP, Oracle, or a third-party application.
AI & Advanced Analytics
• Identify, prioritize, and deliver Generative AI Use Cases for Enterprise Applications
leveraging AI services (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, SAP Joule, Oracle AI, Azure OpenAI)
to embed intelligence into ERP-driven business processes.
• Build and scale Machine Learning Models for demand forecasting, supply chain
optimization, financial planning, anomaly detection, and process automation across ERP
platforms.

Drive Forecasting & Optimization initiatives that convert historical ERP data (from SAP,
Oracle, or similar) into predictive and prescriptive insights.
• Lead Intelligent Automation efforts automating repetitive data tasks, report generation, and
exception-based alerting through AI-powered workflows integrated with enterprise
applications.

title: Distriktsansvarlig Selger til BGFIX
description:
BGFIX er et etablert selskap i vekst som tilbyr sikkerhets- og beskyttelsesløsninger til byggebransjen. Selskapet har over 20 års erfaring og tilbyr blant annet byggegjerder, porter, fallsikring og andre løsninger som bidrar til tryggere byggeplasser.

Etter sterk vekst i Sverige og Danmark tar BGFIX nå neste store steg og etablerer seg i Norge. I forbindelse med satsingen søker selskapet en distriktsansvarlig selger som blir BGFIX' første medarbeider på det norske markedet.

Her får du en unik mulighet til å være med fra starten og bygge opp salget, kundebasen og BGFIX' tilstedeværelse i Norge – med et etablert konsept og et erfarent team i Sverige i ryggen.

Arbeidsbeskrivelse

Som distriktsansvarlig selger i BGFIX får du en nøkkelrolle i etableringen og utviklingen av selskapets salg i Norge. Du har base i Oslo-området og jobber primært med kunder og prosjekter innenfor cirka 1,5–2 timers kjøreavstand.

Du har ansvar for hele salgsprosessen, fra prospektering og første kontakt til kundemøter, behovsanalyse, tilbud, oppfølging og signering. Hovedfokuset ligger på nysalg og på å bygge en sterk pipeline med byggherrer, totalentreprenører og andre relevante aktører i byggebransjen.

Du jobber både med egen prospektering og innkommende leads og får en sentral rolle i å bygge opp BGFIX' kundebase og langsiktige tilstedeværelse i Norge. Rollen innebærer stor frihet og mye eget ansvar, samtidig som du får tett samarbeid og støtte fra organisasjonen i Sverige.

Arbeidsoppgaver

• Drive hele salgsprosessen fra prospektering til signert avtale og videre oppfølging
• Bygge opp og utvikle BGFIX' salg og kundebase i Norge
• Prospektere og skape nye forretningsmuligheter
• Booke og gjennomføre digitale og fysiske kundemøter
• Kontakte og utvikle relasjoner med byggherrer, totalentreprenører og andre relevante beslutningstakere
• Gjennomføre behovsanalyser og presentere BGFIX' løsninger basert på kundens behov
• Utarbeide tilbud og sikre rask og strukturert oppfølging
• Bygge og utvikle en sterk egen pipeline
• Utvikle eksisterende kunder og identifisere muligheter for mersalg og gjentakende forretninger
• Jobbe strukturert i HubSpot med aktiviteter, pipeline og oppfølging

Din profil

Du er en selvstendig, forretningsorientert og konkurranseinnstilt person som motiveres av muligheten til å være med på å bygge opp noe fra grunnen av. Tydelige mål og resultater driver deg, og du har et sterkt eget initiativ til å skape nye forretningsmuligheter, booke møter og drive salgsprosesser fremover.

Som person er du strukturert og utholdende og trives i en rolle med stort eget ansvar. Du har tålmodigheten og utholdenheten som kreves for å drive lengre salgsprosesser fremover, samtidig som du bygger langsiktige kunderelasjoner. Du er profesjonell, god til å bygge relasjoner og trives med å være ute hos kunder og på byggeplasser.

Fremfor alt motiveres du av muligheten til å bli BGFIX' første medarbeider på plass i Norge og være med på å legge grunnlaget for selskapets videre vekst i det norske markedet.

Kvalifikasjoner

• Erfaring med B2B-salg
• Erfaring fra bygge-, utleie- eller logistikkbransjen
• Erfaring med prospektering og nysalg
• Evne til å drive en salgsprosess selvstendig
• Flytende norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
• Gode kommunikasjons- og relasjonsbyggende ferdigheter
• Gode IT-kunnskaper og erfaring med strukturert arbeid i CRM-systemer
• Førerkort klasse B
• Mulighet til å ha base i Oslo-området

Det er en fordel om du har

• Eget nettverk og etablerte kontakter i byggebransjen
• Erfaring med salg mot bygge- og entreprenørbransjen, for eksempel byggherrer og totalentreprenører
• Forståelse for byggeplasser, byggematerialer eller relaterte produkter
• Erfaring med lengre og mer komplekse salgsprosesser
• Flytende svensk, både muntlig og skriftlig

BGFIX tilbyr

• Fastlønn
• Bonusordning knyttet til resultater og måloppnåelse
• Tjenestepensjon
• Helseforsikring
• En nøkkelrolle i BGFIX' etablering og videre vekst i Norge
• Mulighet til å være med på å bygge opp salget og kundebasen i det norske markedet fra grunnen av
• Stor frihet og mye eget ansvar
• Løpende kompetanseutvikling innen salg
• Et engasjert team med korte beslutningsveier og store muligheter til å påvirke

Praktisk informasjon

Oppstart: Etter avtale
Stilling: Heltid
Sted: Oslo-området, med hovedsakelig salgsområde innenfor cirka 1,5–2 timers kjøreavstand fra Oslo. Reiser til større prosjekter i andre deler av Norge kan forekomme.
Arbeidssted: Du jobber fra hjemmekontor
Arbeidstid: Mandag–fredag kl. 07.00–16.00, med fleksibilitet ut fra kundenes og byggebransjens arbeidstider

Du får også mulighet til å delta i en ettårig salgsutdanning med Mikael Arndt, inkludert 25 sertifiserende kurs innen salg og ukentlige liveforelesninger. Du får i tillegg mulighet til å delta på store salgsarrangementer i Stockholm for videre faglig og personlig utvikling.

I denne rekrutteringen samarbeider BGFIX med rekrutteringsselskapet Saleshub. Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte ansvarlig rekrutterer på maya.aslan@saleshub.se.

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad!
