title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Technical Project Manager

At OQC, we aren’t just theorising about the future; we’re building it. Born from a philosophy of bold innovation, we’ve successfully transitioned quantum computing from an academic dream into a commercial reality. The most exciting thing is that we’re just getting started and we’ve recently closed our £260 million Series C funding round – the largest fundraise ever completed by a quantum computing company in Europe.

The Purpose

As a Technical Project Manager, you'll lead complex technical and scientific projects that are critical to OQC's next stage of growth. You'll turn ambiguity into action, bringing structure to evolving challenges and aligning technical teams, resources and priorities to deliver outcomes that advance our wider technology and business objectives.

The Role

Working within the Office of the CSO, you'll take end-to-end ownership of complex projects, from defining the delivery strategy through to successful completion. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you'll work across technical disciplines and business functions, influencing senior stakeholders, navigating competing priorities and making evidence-based decisions that keep ambitious programmes moving forward.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Lead complex technical and scientific projects from definition through to delivery, owning scope, outcomes, timelines, resources and quality.
  • Turn evolving or ambiguous technical requirements into clear delivery strategies, plans, milestones and priorities.
  • Own project risks, issues and dependencies, anticipating barriers and driving effective mitigation and resolution.
  • Lead project governance and decision-making, aligning technical teams, senior stakeholders and sponsors around priorities and accountabilities.
  • Manage project budgets and forecasts, identifying financial and resource constraints and providing clear recommendations.
  • Challenge assumptions and delivery approaches where needed, using evidence to influence decisions and protect project outcomes.
  • Drive continuous improvement across project delivery, sharing expertise and strengthening OQC's project management practices, tools and governance.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience independently leading complex projects within technical, engineering, scientific or similarly complex environments.
  • A track record of delivering through ambiguity, changing requirements and significant cross-functional dependencies.
  • Experience defining project delivery strategies and selecting appropriate methodologies rather than simply executing predefined plans.
  • Strong risk, issue, dependency, budget and resource management capability.
  • Proven ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and secure decisions needed for delivery.
  • Strong project governance, reporting, facilitation and presentation skills, including communicating complex information to senior stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of Agile, Waterfall and other relevant project delivery approaches.
  • Sound judgement, decisiveness and the ability to operate independently while knowing when strategic, financial or resource decisions require escalation.
  • No specific formal qualification is required; equivalent practical experience independently delivering complex technical projects will be considered.

The 'Nice-to-Haves'

  • Experience leading significant multidisciplinary technical or scientific programmes or workstreams.
  • Experience within an R&D, deep-tech or scientific organisation.
  • Experience developing or improving a PMO or wider project management capability.
  • Experience presenting project recommendations and delivery decisions to executive-level stakeholders.
  • A recognised project management qualification or certification such as PRINCE2, Agile, APM or equivalent.
  • A relevant technical, scientific or engineering qualification.

Why Join OQC

You will join a world-class team at the forefront of the next computational era. We offer a culture of bold innovation, the chance to work with unique lab infrastructure, and the opportunity to see your work redefine the limits of computation.

Does this sound like you? Technical skills 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, with a strong focus on backend development; Strong background in backend development and cloud architecture; Proven experience in the development and ownership of Io T or smart device products and associated platforms; Strong hands-on AWS experience required, including services such as Io T Core, Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, and Cloud Front; experience with MQTT, Kafka (or similar event streaming platforms), and event-driven architecture is a strong advantage; Proficiency in CI/CD practices, including automation of cloud infrastructure using tools such as Cloud Formation or Terraform; Demonstrated leadership in programming language choices, with a focus on making informed decisions for the project; Backend development experience in a similar strongly-typed backend language is required; familiarity with g RPC and exposure to Rust is an advantage; Commitment to implementing and maintaining robust testing processes; Familiarity with Io T protocols, connectivity, and hardware considerations; Strong security mindset, with experience implementing IAM least-privilege access, TLS encryption, and data protection practices in line with frameworks such as POPIA or GDPR; Excellent project management and organisational skills, with a track record of delivering projects on time and within scope; Experience working in an agile development environment. Driven and a self-starter; Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment; Excellent collaboration and communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders. 4. Who is Power Optimal?

Power Optimal is an African leader in renewable energy technology solutions with an ambition to transform how hot water is generated and used. We are a small but fast-growing, high-performance team with high standards and big ambitions. We strive for excellence in everything we do. Our aim is to be transformative and collaborative in our work.

We focus on speed, scale, smart resourcefulness and unbounded optimism. We never start with 'no.' We're solution-oriented and focus on the outcome and the impact of any project or priority. We're a curious bunch, creative and a little quirky. We debate things passionately in team meetings and stand-ups. We agree and disagree on how the world should work, but we all agree on making a big difference through our work at Power Optimal. Which is why we love it here and never take it for granted. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: EHS Professional
description:
The Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Professional reviews, evaluates, and analyzes work environments and is responsible for designing policies and procedures to ensure adherence to regulations on safety, health, and the environment. They also design programs to prevent disease or injury to workers and damage to the environment. The incumbent analyzes regulatory required compliance and technical issues, and communicates those analyses with clients, peers, and with regulatory agencies when needed.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The essential functions/duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete list, and other duties will be assigned based on the incumbent’s role within EHS programs and changing needs of the employer.

1. Participates in achieving the goals of the safety organization.

2. Plans, implements and coordinates safety programs and procedures.

3. Keeps current with any changes in regulations and implements changes accordingly. Ensures manuals, policies and procedures are in place and clarifies intent to support adherence to regulations and company expectations.

4. Collaborates with other facility/site safety staff to support consistency and knowledge sharing across all sites as appropriate.

5. Supports and mentors the development of technical safety skills for employees and leaders in the facility.

6. Executes the safety vision and plan for the facility and mentors the staff in achieving that vision.

7. Conducts or coordinates employee training in areas of safety, regulations, hazardous condition monitoring, and use of safety equipment.

8. Maintains training matrix for site specific required training.

9. Investigates incidents (near hit, injury) including:

a. Follows notification protocol internal to EC and EHS for each specific site.

b. Aids in initial care and follow up care with injured employees and case management.

c. Investigates incidents.

d. Ensures incident report has been completed by and distributed to the appropriate parties within established timelines.

10. Leads and documents appropriate risk/hazard assessments. Conducts corresponding follow-ups and implementation of corrective action items to support minimization and/or elimination of incidents that have the potential to cause harm to one of EHS's employees, contractors, or visitors.

11. Ergonomic Initiative Focus: Focuses on work that takes employees out of the neutral zone, creating body positioning issues, which may increase risk of musculoskeletal disorders.

12. Upon award of a new project, collaborates with the project team in developing the

Environmental Health and Safety plan (EHSP) for the project. Additionally, perform walks with supervision to become familiar with the upcoming scope of work and to identify potential issues (hazards, impacts) that need to be mitigated.

13. Effectively communicates the health and safety goals, objectives, performance expectations, and metrics to employees at each work site.

14. Consults with and provides support/guidance to employees regarding both personal medical and work-related injuries to identify opportunities for improved safety performance, risk reduction and cost reduction.

15. Performs and administers safety audits including inspection of safety facilities, machinery, and safety equipment to identify and correct potential hazards, and to ensure safety regulation compliance.

16. Performs regular (weekly) audit recaps and distributes as directed by supervisor.

17. Oversees facility safety inventory including supplies, equipment and training materials.

18. Analyzes and utilizes data to set safety priorities and develop action plans.

19. Responds as intermediary in situations involving team member safety and site safety.

20. Participates in pre-task plan/job briefing reviews.

21. Represents EC to work with the GC/Client/Owner EHS professionals to provide guidance and council overall project safety.

22. Site specific EHS professionals will also follow the EHS Internal Roles of site EHS guidelines and work with the project teams to detail any specific needs.

Requirements

  • Bachelors (BA/BS) degree in Safety Management, Industrial Hygiene, or related subject from an accredited school; or
  • Associates (AA/AS) degree in Safety Management, Industrial Hygiene, or related subject from an accredited school; and at least two or more years related experience and/or training in professional safety in the field; or
  • Successful completion of an accredited EHS Apprentice program.

Any equivalent combination of education and experience which provides the knowledge, skills and abilities to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position will be considered.

  • Possession of or ability to obtain and maintain a valid Oregon driver license.
  • OSHA 30 in construction required or equivalent certification.

  • Frequent Travel for project visits is required, typically 40% to 60%, with some overnight travel as needed.

title: Quantum Engineer - QPU Design
description:
Quantum Engineer – QPU Design

At OQC, we aren’t just theorising about the future; we’re building it. Born from a philosophy of bold innovation, we’ve successfully transitioned quantum computing from an academic ambition into a commercial reality. The most exciting thing is that we’re just getting started.

The Purpose

Help design the next generation of OQC’s superconducting quantum processors.

As a Quantum Engineer specialising in QPU design, you’ll develop and simulate novel processor architectures, circuit layouts and superconducting components. Your work will help improve gate performance, readout fidelity and the scalability of OQC’s quantum processors, directly contributing to our future technology roadmap.

The Role

Working within our Quantum Science & Exploratory Research team, you’ll collaborate with senior researchers to take ownership of scientific and engineering projects across the full development lifecycle—from initial design and simulation through to implementation, data analysis and technical recommendations.

You’ll combine electromagnetic modelling, superconducting circuit theory, scientific software development and analysis of experimental data. You’ll also help maintain OQC’s QPU design toolchain, improve our simulation methods and translate complex scientific findings into practical design decisions.

This role may involve occasional domestic and international travel for conferences and collaborative research programmes.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Design and simulate novel superconducting quantum processors, optimising architectures, circuit layouts and device performance.
  • Develop QPU designs that support low-error quantum gates, fast high-fidelity readout and increasingly scalable processor architectures.
  • Build and improve advanced design methodologies for superconducting circuits using electromagnetic and circuit-level simulation.
  • Maintain OQC’s QPU design and simulation codebase, contributing through collaborative development, pull requests and code reviews.
  • Analyse design and experimental data to identify processor limitations and translate findings into clear technical recommendations.
  • Own scientific research projects from experimental or simulation design through to analysis, documentation and reporting.
  • Contribute to the QSER roadmap, share technical knowledge across the team and represent OQC through conferences, collaborations and scientific publications.

What We’re Looking For

  • A PhD, or equivalent multi-year commercial or R&D experience, involving the measurement, design or operation of quantum systems.
  • Experience designing superconducting quantum processors, including circuit layout and electromagnetic simulation using tools such as HFSS, Sonnet, COMSOL or equivalent.
  • Strong knowledge of microwave engineering and superconducting circuit theory.
  • Experience in at least one relevant quantum or superconducting-device field, such as:
    • Superconducting qubits
    • Trapped ions, photonics, neutral atoms or solid-state spin systems
    • Superconducting resonators or SQUIDs
    • Microwave kinetic-inductance detectors
    • Nano-electromechanical resonators or surface-acoustic-wave devices
  • Strong Python skills, or experience with a comparable language, for automation, scientific analysis and data processing.
  • The ability to distil complex scientific information and communicate findings clearly to technical stakeholders.
  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to take ownership of research activities and deliver detailed, accurate work.
  • A creative, curious and adaptable approach to solving complex scientific and engineering problems.

The ‘Nice-to-Haves’

  • Advanced electromagnetic-simulation experience applied specifically to superconducting qubit design.
  • Experience with qubit parameter-extraction methods such as black-box quantisation, energy-participation-ratio analysis or circuit analysis.
  • Knowledge of numerical or computational optimisation methods applied to QPU design.
  • Experience comparing experimental measurements with Hamiltonian models, circuit simulations or electromagnetic simulations.
  • Experience developing or improving scientific design and simulation software.
  • A track record of publishing scientific research or presenting technical results, particularly within superconducting circuits or quantum processor design.
  • Experience supporting or mentoring junior researchers and sharing technical knowledge across multidisciplinary teams.

Why Join OQC

You’ll join a multidisciplinary team working at the forefront of superconducting quantum processor development. This is an opportunity to influence the physical architecture of future quantum computers, working across advanced simulation, scientific software and experimental data.

You’ll have genuine ownership of technically challenging research, access to specialist quantum engineering expertise and the opportunity to see your designs contribute directly to OQC’s next generation of processors.

Benefits

title: Principal Engineer
description:
At Suitsupply, we combine radical style with radical technology. We are looking for a Principal Engineer — the most senior hands-on engineer in the company: you design, you build, and you ship alongside our teams. You set the engineering standard for an entire domain, and you make it stick — in the code, in the pipelines, and in how our teams adopt AI-native ways of working. Expect a roughly 50/50 split: half your time accelerating projects inside teams, half driving the cross-cutting standards everyone works to.
What you will do:
  • Set the standard: own the cross-cutting standards backlog for your domains — unified observability and monitoring, alerting, release and deployment processes, CI/CD templates, and shared packages — and make them binding: non-compliant code does not merge.
  • Stay in the code: design, prototype and build on the hardest cross-team problems — the migrations, integrations and foundations no single team can own.
  • Jump-start delivery: parachute into projects that need momentum — run the technical discovery, shape the solution, get the first implementation moving with the team. You accelerate teams.
  • Embed, don't tower: work inside teams to raise the bar in place, pairing with Tech Leads and Engineering Managers.
  • Enforce through systems: skills-per-repo, PR guardrails and automated checks carry the standard, so it scales without you hand-reviewing every merge.
  • Make us AI-native: drive agentic development as the default way of working, on a drumbeat you set with the Engineering Managers.
  • Cover the gaps: step into teams without a Tech Lead to keep delivery and quality on track while we hire.
  • Pair at the top: partner with Engineering Leadership on domain architecture. You set the standard; the Tech Leads spread it.
Who you are:
  • 10+ years of engineering, with recent staff- or principal-level scope at a strong product or tech company.
  • You have carried technical responsibility across at least three domains — not one deep silo. This is a hard requirement.
  • You have joined an existing ecosystem and changed it — change management in a landscape you didn't build is core to this job; greenfield-only track records don't clear the bar.
  • Hands-on across the stack and still shipping code weekly; deep in at least one of .NET and Azure event-driven backends, large-scale commerce ecosystems, or integration and data platforms.
  • You have made standards stick across teams that didn't report to you — through tooling, guardrails and example, not decks.
  • Already ahead of us on AI-assisted and agentic development at enterprise scale — multi-team, inside an existing ecosystem. We expect to learn this from you, not to teach it to you — and you can show a team or codebase you made measurably faster.
  • You explain hard things simply — to engineers, to product, to the board. If you truly know it, you can say it plainly.
  • Zero direct reports, by design — and that suits you. Your authority is technical, and on domain standards it is final.
What you will get:
  • Competitive compensation — we benchmark this role against the top of the Dutch tech market, not against retail. A freelance-first start is possible if that is how you work.
  • A real top-of-ladder IC seat: final say on domain standards, a direct line to the Head of Engineering and the Director, and no management detour required to keep growing.
  • Scale that shows: ~16 product teams, a global Shopify migration, own-built Custom Made and Radical Personal platforms, and an ERP transition — with the mandate to make it all AI-native.
  • Autonomy without layers of sign-off
  • Hybrid working: three days in the Amsterdam HQ, two remote — flexible in both directions once you're up to speed.
  • A 40% discount on Suitsupply product, and a working wardrobe you'll actually want to wear.

description:
MORROW MEDICAL

MORROW Medical is a physician-led longevity and lifestyle medicine clinic in Singapore, focused on helping individuals understand, optimise, and protect their long-term health. We combine comprehensive health screening, preventive care, and evidence-based lifestyle medicine to identify early signs of metabolic, cardiovascular, and functional change—often before disease develops. Our fully licensed doctors diagnose conditions, prescribe medication, and manage chronic disease where required, while also guiding patients through personalised lifestyle interventions that support sustainable improvement. From preventive screening to ongoing medical management, MORROW Medical delivers integrated care designed to strengthen function, resilience, and long-term health outcomes.

Employment Type: Part-time

Location: Singapore

Reports To: Head of Human Performance & Exercise Science

Role Overview

Physiotherapists at MORROW are clinical movement specialists, responsible for delivering comprehensive, evidence-based rehabilitation and performance optimisation care. They integrate insights from medical assessments, diagnostics, and functional movement analysis to design safe, individualised treatment plans that restore mobility, build resilience, and prevent injury.

This role demands strong clinical reasoning, clear patient education, and close interdisciplinary collaboration. Physiotherapists are expected to monitor outcomes, adapt interventions based on progress, and empower patients through education and long-term movement strategies. In addition to direct patient care, the role supports clinical excellence through accurate documentation, participation in wellness initiatives, and collaboration with physicians, health coaches, nutritionists, and the Head of Clinical Operations to uphold quality standards, internal audits, and licensing compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive physical assessments and develop individualized treatment plans for patients.
  • Implement evidence-based physiotherapy interventions to improve mobility, strength, and function.
  • Monitor patient progress and adjust treatment plans accordingly.
  • Educate patients and caregivers on exercises, injury prevention, and rehabilitation strategies.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure holistic patient care.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of patient records and treatment outcomes.
  • Participate in health and wellness initiatives within the organization.
  • Collaborate with physicians, health coaches, and nutritionists as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Assisting the Head of Clinical Operations on quality checks and internal audits to maintain licensing compliance

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Physiotherapy from a recognized institution.
  • Valid registration or licensure with the relevant professional board or council.
  • Minimum of 2 years clinical experience in musculoskeletal, neurological, cardiac or other rehabilitation.
  • Proficiency in conducting physical assessments and using therapeutic modalities.
  • Familiarity with electronic medical records and clinical documentation standards.

Preferred Skills or Traits

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to engage effectively with patients and teams.
  • Empathetic and patient-centered approach to care.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development and evidence-based practice.
  • Experience and interest in lifestyle medicine or integrative health settings is a plus.

Benefits

This is a career-defining opportunity to shape the future of longevity medicine while working alongside world-class clinicians and technologists. You will contribute to initiatives that directly lead to extending human healthspan while establishing Singapore as the global hub for longevity innovation.

At MORROW, you will not only help define operational excellence but also build the culture, rhythm, and future of interventions. You won't just be joining a team. You will be co-creating tomorrow.

MORROW Medical is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional (USFCO109USFIH104)
description:
ProSidian Seeks a Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional - Construction/Industrial Hygiene (USFCO109USFIH104) as an Engagement Team Member generally located across the Savannah River Site / Aiken, South Carolina, supporting Environmental Management Sector requirements to support an engagement for a liquid waste contractor (Savannah River Remediation [SRMC]) at the Savannah River Site in Aiken, SC, which is owned by the U.S. Department of Energy..

JOB OVERVIEW

Provide services and support as a Construction/Industrial Hygiene Functional Area Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional (USFCO109USFIH104) under Labor Category: Health and Safety Specialist at Savannah River Site / Aiken, South Carolina. Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional - Construction/Industrial Hygiene (USFCO109USFIH104) works collaboratively as part of the ProSidian Engagement Team as Exempt [1099] personnel. Dedicated Planned Labor Hours (DPLH) of 1250 Straight Time (ST) Estimated Annual Quantity (Hrs. Per Yr.) | 0 Overtime Time (OT) Estimated Annual Quantity (Hrs. Per Yr.). This is a Labor Hour Subcontract or Contract W-2 (IRS-1099) position, and ProSidian reserves the right to convert to a Full-Time ProSidian employed W-2 Position. The role(s) are located at Savannah River Site / Aiken, South Carolina, with an identified Work Site Address (121 Richland Ave E, Aiken, SC 29801, USA), providing Construction/Industrial Hygiene functions working to provide BOA Support Services for multiple department requirement Service Areas (SA) for Savannah River Remediation LLC (The SRMC/LW Contractor) at the U.S. Department of Energy | Savannah River Site (DOE-SRS) in Aiken, SC to support the evolving needs of the organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES - Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional - Construction/Industrial Hygiene (USFCO109USFIH104)

The Certified Industrial Hygiene (CIH) Technician / Safety Professional will provide on-site occupational-health and construction-safety support as a ProSidian Engagement Team Member supporting US Fusion and Specialty Construction | US Rubber and Specialty Applications at the U.S. Department of Energy’s Savannah River Site near Aiken, South Carolina. The position is primarily responsible for supporting the anticipation, recognition, evaluation, documentation, and control of workplace health hazards. The technician will also perform assigned safety-professional duties involving field inspections, hazard-analysis reviews, pre-job planning, worker observations, corrective-action tracking, and compliance support. Activities requiring independent CIH or CSP professional judgment will be performed by, or under the direction of, an appropriately credentialed professional.

Responsibilities and Duties

Industrial Hygiene Responsibilities

  • Support qualitative and quantitative exposure assessments for assigned facilities, work packages, processes, materials, and field conditions.
  • Assist with developing exposure-monitoring strategies based on work scope, potential hazards, exposure routes, historical data, similar-exposure groups, and possible acute or chronic health effects.
  • Conduct personal, area, task-based, and direct-reading monitoring using approved methods and calibrated equipment.
  • Monitor potential exposures to airborne contaminants, respirable crystalline silica, asbestos, lead, metals, welding fumes, particulates, nuisance dust, volatile organic compounds, solvents, coatings, adhesives, chemicals, noise, vibration, heat and cold stress, illumination, biological agents, and ergonomic stressors.
  • Prepare, calibrate, operate, inspect, maintain, and store industrial-hygiene instruments and sampling equipment.
  • Maintain accurate field notes, calibration logs, sampling records, chain-of-custody forms, laboratory reports, exposure notifications, and data-quality documentation.
  • Coordinate the submission of samples to approved analytical laboratories and track results through receipt and evaluation.
  • Assist the supervising CIH with interpreting monitoring results against applicable OSHA exposure limits and authorized NIOSH, ACGIH, DOE, and project-specific occupational-exposure criteria.
  • Promptly report suspected overexposures, unusual monitoring results, worker symptoms, complaints, control failures, or changing exposure conditions.
  • Communicate approved monitoring findings and protective requirements to workers, supervisors, project management, occupational medicine, and site industrial-hygiene personnel.
  • Recommend and help validate controls using the hierarchy of controls, emphasizing elimination, substitution, isolation, containment, engineering controls, local exhaust ventilation, and improved work practices before reliance on PPE.
  • Evaluate the implementation and effectiveness of respiratory-protection, ventilation, hearing-conservation, heat-stress, chemical-management, hazardous-material, and ergonomic controls.
  • Support respirator selection, medical-evaluation coordination, fit-testing, cartridge-change determinations, equipment inspections, and respiratory-protection documentation.
  • Review Safety Data Sheets, chemical inventories, work packages, procedures, permits, Job Hazard Analyses, Activity Hazard Analyses, and pre-task plans for occupational-health hazards and required controls.
  • Assist with reviewing new or modified activities involving hazardous materials, carcinogens, highly toxic substances, process gases, coatings, adhesives, sealants, solvents, and other chemicals before their introduction into the workplace.
  • Support investigations of suspected occupational illnesses, employee exposure concerns, monitoring anomalies, and failed industrial-hygiene controls.
  • Prepare or deliver approved hazard-specific training and technical briefings for supervisors, craft personnel, employees, and subcontractors.
  • Coordinate with qualified radiological-control personnel when activities interface with radiological areas or requirements. Industrial-hygiene duties do not replace independently assigned radiation-protection or radiological-control functions.

Safety Professional Support Responsibilities

  • Maintain a visible field presence and support safe execution of authorized construction, installation, maintenance, demolition, coating, lining, rubber, fusion, testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Support implementation of the applicable Safety Management System, Worker Protection Plan, Integrated Safety Management requirements, site procedures, and project-specific safety plans.
  • Participate in daily coordination meetings, plan-of-the-day meetings, pre-job briefings, safety meetings, constructability reviews, work-package planning, readiness reviews, walkdowns, and commissioning activities.
  • Review JHAs, AHAs, work packages, permits, procedures, and pre-task plans for completeness, changing conditions, industrial-hygiene concerns, and appropriate protective measures.
  • Verify that identified occupational-health and safety hazards are controlled before work begins and that controls remain effective during execution.
  • Conduct and document field inspections, worker observations, housekeeping assessments, and compliance reviews.
  • Identify unsafe acts, unsafe conditions, uncontrolled exposures, and noncompliant practices; communicate findings and track corrective actions through closure.
  • Exercise stop-work responsibility and immediately elevate imminent-danger conditions, suspected overexposures, uncontrolled hazards, or serious noncompliance in accordance with project procedures and delegated authority.
  • Support fact-finding, incident investigations, causal analyses, corrective-action development, lessons learned, and verification of corrective-action effectiveness.
  • Assist with evaluating high-hazard activities involving confined spaces, hazardous energy, hot work, electrical work, elevated work, excavation, cranes, rigging, lifting, mobile equipment, pressure testing, and emergency-response considerations.
  • Coordinate occupational-health and safety requirements with project management, field supervision, craft personnel, subcontractors, quality, engineering, environmental, occupational medicine, emergency management, and radiological-control organizations.
  • Protect controlled, proprietary, personal, and project-sensitive information and maintain records in accordance with applicable document-control, records-management, and quality requirements.

Desired Qualifications For Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional - Construction/Industrial Hygiene (USFCO109USFIH104) (USFCO109USFIH104) Candidates:

Standard Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience performing industrial-hygiene field monitoring, exposure assessment, instrument calibration, data collection, recordkeeping, and control verification.

title: AVR Specialist - Sudan
description:
• Place: Khartoum / Sudan
  • Starting date: asap
  • Duration of contract: 4 months (renewable upon fundings)
  • Closing date for applications: 20 September

Humanity & Inclusion is an independent and impartial aid organisation working in situations of poverty and exclusion, conflict and disaster. The organisation works alongside people with disabilities and vulnerable populations, taking action and bearing witness in order to respond to their essential needs, improve their living conditions and promote respect for their dignity and fundamental rights.

Since its creation in 1982, HI has run development & humanitarian projects in more than 55 countries and responded to numerous emergencies. Today, we have a budget of approximately 200 million euros, with 4,000 employees worldwide

At Handicap International-Humanity & Inclusion, we truly believe in the importance of inclusion and diversity within our organisation. This is why we are engaged to a disability policy to encourage the inclusion and integration of people with disabilities.

Please indicate if you require any special accommodation, even at the first interview.

For more information about HI

YOUR MISSION

The AVR Specialist contributes within Sudan to the implementation of the mandate and the 10-year strategy of Humanity & Inclusion. (S)he ensures optimal quality and impact of AVR projects implemented in Sudan through a delegation system with appropriate control mechanisms. (S)he contributes to the sound management and successful functioning of the overall organisation through paradigm shifts.

Based in Khartoum, the AVR Specialist is responsible for developing, driving and monitoring the AVR technical strategy, particularly on explosive ordnance risk education (EORE), victim assistance (VA) specific efforts, community engagement, and links with land release. (S)he will lead capacity building of HI operational staff and local project partners on EORE and VA, as well as ensuring the quality control materials/messaged developed and activities implemented.

The AVR Specialist will have 5 main responsabilities:

  • Responsibility 1: Expertise
    • Contribute to national and/or regional strategies in line with the global strategie
      • Provide technical input on AVR to theProgramme StratOp within her/his scope, in line with the global AVR StraTech, and ensure relevant follow up
      • Lead the development and monitoring of the AVR sectoral sub-strategy
    • Ensure the assessment of needs, risks and conflict sensitivity in relation to the AVR strategy and operational activities, and make recommendations
      • Conduct regular analysis of project data and external secondary data on AVR needs and interventions, in close collaboration with the Chief of Operations, MEAL team and partners
      • Contribute to the AVR context analysis, together with the Chief of Operations
    • Lead the development and update of HI’s SOPs, tools and guidance materials on EORE and VA specific efforts
    • Provide technical support on EORE and VA specific efforts in line with HI’s global technical frameworks, the International Mine Action Standards, and Sudan National Mine Action Standards
      • Provide adequate technical guidance and support to Project Managers when relevant (adapt standards to PM’s tools, contribute to proposal writing and reporting) in line with strategies, standards and mandatory transversal approaches
      • Ensure adequate support to multi-sector responses within and across projects, including on victim assistance, in line with the other specialists
      • Ensure a local sectoral watch of best practices to adopt within her/his sectoral scope
      • Contribute to recruitment and briefing when relevant
  • Control & monitor the technical quality and the relevance of EORE activities and VA specific efforts implemented by HI Sudan and local partners
    • Ensure regular technical quality control of projects and programmes and issue warnings and recommendations
    • Technically validate EORE messages, materials and approaches prior to dissemination
    • Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations, if applicable, in her/his sectoral scope
  • Ensure technical learning from AVR projects
  • Ensure compliance of the AVR technical proposition with nexus stakes
  • Contribute to the development of AVR research and innovation projects in the region when relevant
  • Contribute to the AVR professional channel facilitation within the program
    • Participate in the global animation of AVR, EORE and VA professional channels
    • Animate a local talent pool in EORE and VA, and ensure co-development and monitoring of professional development plans
  • Responsibility 2: Capacity building & technical assistance on EORE and VA
    • Support HI partners to manage EORE and VA activities
    • Lead the identification of EORE/VA training needs, the design and update of training materials, and the delivery of trainings for HI and partner staff
    • Mentor and provide technical oversight to the EORE Senior Technical Officer for the implementation of a mass and digital media project
    • Provide technical advice to HI/partner project teams on the development and field testing of EORE messages and materials, such as session aids, IEC materials and digital/mass media campaigns
    • Engage other HI specialists nationally, regionally or globally in relation to VA broader and specific efforts, in order to establish identification, assessment and referral pathways
    • Lead an assessment of the service and referral landscape and barriers to accessing services for EO victims, in collaboration with protection and inclusion specialists
  • Responsibility 3: Influence
    • Contribute to the local external prestige and influence of HI’s expertise in AVR
    • Represent the technical expertise of HI in the Mine Action Area of Responsibility and any relevant Technical Working Groups, together with the Chief of Operations
    • Support liaison between HI and the Sudan National Mine Action Authority, and participate in relevant policy fora
    • Contribute to advocacy on specific themes in line with the global advocacy priorities
    • Contribute to communication messages locally in line with the global communication priorities
  • Responsibility 4: Business development
    • Ensure the development of major opportunities or new AVR projects in the region
      • Lead or contribute to the design and writing of new AVR projects
      • Identify & transform major opportunities under her/his scope
      • Identify & develop local partnerships and/or consortium with NGOs, Institutions, Companies on technical priorities or important topics in the region under her/his scope
      • Support senior management in representation with mine action donors, when needed
  • Responsibility 5: Emergency preparedness and response responsibilities
    • Contribute to the support or implementation of emergency preparedness actions of the programme(s) and, during an emergency, adapts her/his working modality to contribute to an effective HI humanitarian response.

The situation in Khartoum is relatively calm. The city has been destroyed by the ongoing conflict and most authorities, NGOs and agencies are in the process of reopening their offices in Khartoum. The route to reach the base goes via: Nairobi (or directly through Port Sudan international airport – depending on Visa process). In terms of conditions, the teams are housed in a collective guesthouse. The office will be embedded through local partner;

Other competencies

You have strong interpersonal and intercultural skills, with good communication and negotiation skills

Languages: fluency in English is mandatory and Arabic is a real plus

Benefits

At HI, the conditions offered are up to your commitment and adapted to the context of your mission:

title: Estate Gardener
description:

The role will include a broad range of gardening duties, including growing fruit, vegetables and flowers, maintaining beds and borders, and training plants. Experience using a range of garden machinery, including ride-on and pedestrian mowers, strimmers and hedge cutters, is essential.

Competitive salary

27 days annual leave

Pension Scheme

Regular Personal and Professional Development Opportunities

A rewarding, caring working environment in a stunning location and with beautiful surroundings

Free parking

Employee Assistance Programme

Access to Product Discounts

title: Plant Administrator – McCloud Power Station
description:
We are ERock!

ERock (NYSE: EROC) is enabling energy for a new era. ERock delivers onsite utility-grade power that gets customers up and running quickly, while supporting long-term grid development. ERock’s proprietary natural gas generators help critical facilities address grid constraints, interconnection delays, and outage risks while accelerating speed-to-power for new and expanding operations. Trusted by data centers, utilities, manufacturers, healthcare systems and government organizations, ERock engineers for rapid deployment, long-duration reliability, low local emissions, and scalable performance to meet the evolving energy demands of today and tomorrow.


Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and detail-oriented Plant Administrator to support operations at ERock’s McCloud Power Station. This role supports the administrative foundation required for a mission-critical microgrid facility by managing site documentation, procurement coordination, contractor and visitor logistics, HR support, compliance records, and operational reporting.


This position is site-based and serves as a key support function to the Plant Manager and site leadership team. The Plant Administrator helps ensure that McCloud’s administrative, compliance, procurement, and communication processes remain structured, accurate, timely, and audit-ready.


This role operates within ERock’s management model, partnering with corporate Human Resources, Finance, Supply Chain, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Engineering, and other support teams to ensure alignment with company standards and processes. This role reports to the Plant Manager at McCloud Power Station.


Key Responsibilities:

Site Administrative Support

  • Maintaining site administrative workflows, records, logs, controlled documents, and reporting files to support efficient day-to-day plant operations.
  • Supporting the Plant Manager and site leadership team with scheduling, meeting coordination, reporting, action item tracking, and general administrative coordination.
  • Maintaining organized records for site procedures, operating processes, contact lists, communication protocols, and site reference materials.
  • Coordinating logistics for site meetings, employee events, training sessions, outage support activities, vendor visits, contractor mobilization, and regulatory or customer visits.
  • Managing office supplies, administrative resources, site forms, shared files, and other support materials needed for effective site execution.

Procurement, Accounting & Contract Administration Support

  • Supporting purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoices, receipts, expense reports, material requests, and other procurement documentation in alignment with company policies.
  • Tracking orders, receiving documentation, packing slips, purchase order status, open commitments, and related procurement records to support timely processing and accurate cost tracking.
  • Reconciling purchase orders, invoices, receipts, and vendor documentation through approved company systems to support accurate and timely payment processing.
  • Maintaining vendor and contractor records, including tax documentation, insurance certificates, safety documentation, contract records, and compliance-related documentation.
  • Assisting the Plant Manager with localized budget tracking, discretionary spending records, financial reporting inputs, and cost variance follow-up.

CMMS, Inventory & Warehouse Support

  • Supporting accurate data entry and administrative updates in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) or applicable enterprise asset management systems.
  • Helping maintain work order documentation, parts usage records, inventory logs, receiving records, and material movement documentation.
  • Supporting warehouse and material control processes by maintaining documentation for parts received, stored, issued, transferred, or returned.
  • Coordinating with maintenance, operations, planning, procurement, and corporate support teams to ensure inventory and work order records are accurate, complete, and traceable.
  • Assisting with documentation needed to support preventive maintenance tracking, corrective maintenance history, spare parts management, and operational readiness reporting.

Human Resources & Training Support

  • Supporting site-level HR activities under the direction of corporate Human Resources and the Plant Manager.
  • Maintaining accurate and confidential records related to timekeeping, labor tracking, onboarding, employee documentation, training completion, certifications, and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinating administrative activities for onboarding, new hire orientation, site access readiness, training schedules, and staffing support.
  • Supporting documentation for programs such as fitness for duty, workers’ compensation, employee communications, and other HR-related processes as directed.
  • Maintaining training files and qualification records that support site compliance, cross-training, workforce readiness, and audit preparation.

Compliance, Safety & Recordkeeping

  • Maintaining accurate and auditable records for safety, training, environmental, operational, procurement, contractor, and compliance-related requirements.
  • Supporting internal and external audits by organizing and providing required documentation in a timely and professional manner.
  • Helping maintain records related to safety meetings, permits, incident reports, corrective actions, environmental documentation, training logs, inspection records, and compliance follow-up items.
  • Supporting documentation related to action items, open issues, monthly reporting inputs, operational KPIs, and site performance reporting.

Communication & Site Coordination

  • Serving as a professional administrative point of contact for site personnel, corporate support teams, vendors, contractors, visitors, and other approved stakeholders.
  • Coordinating visitor scheduling, site access readiness, contractor badging support, meeting logistics, and documentation needed for planned site activities.
  • Supporting consistent communication between McCloud site personnel and corporate teams including HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Engineering, and Supply Chain.
  • Helping ensure required documentation is available, current, and organized for operational reviews, leadership updates, audits, inspections, and stakeholder communications.

Role Scope & Leadership Expectations

  • This role is responsible for execution and organization of site administrative functions that support McCloud Power Station’s operating discipline, compliance posture, and readiness.
  • The Plant Administrator ensures documentation, reporting, procurement support, HR coordination, vendor records, and site administrative systems are accurate, consistent, and reliable.
  • Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, organizational discipline, confidentiality, follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured plant environment.
  • This role serves as a key interface between site personnel and corporate functional teams while supporting the Plant Manager’s execution of site responsibilities.

Supported by evidence-informed practice and data from wearables and lifestyle inputs, MORROW Health helps members recognise patterns, build consistency, and stay accountable—turning insight into everyday action that supports long-term vitality, strength, and clarity, without medical diagnosis or treatment.

Location: Singapore
Reports To: Mindful Movement Zone Lead

Role Overview

As a Pilates Reformer Trainer, you will deliver high-quality, alignment-focused sessions that elevate the member experience beyond traditional Pilates. You will integrate intentional pause, mindful breathwork, functional alignment, and clinical awareness, tailoring classes to the needs of each participant while fostering positive social connection and community.

This role requires precision, deep knowledge of the Pilates method, and the ability to inspire and educate. Trainers will be expected to embody MORROW’s philosophy of mind–body empowerment while delivering programming that is safe, effective, and transformative.

Key Responsibilities

Class Delivery & Mindful Movement

  • Facilitate group and private Pilates Reformer classes, ensuring best-in-class safety, alignment, and member engagement.
  • Integrate mind–body connection, breathwork, and precision cueing into every session.
  • Deliver programming that aligns with MORROW’s carefully curated standards of mindfulness, functional movement, and longevity-focused training.

Programming & Integration

  • Execute MORROW’s Pilates programming, collaborating with the Mindful Movement Zone Lead and Programming Manager.
  • Ensure classes are progressive, safe for all levels, and aligned with the six pillars of Lifestyle Medicine, especially Positive Social Connection.
  • Leverage medical assessment data and recovery needs to personalise sessions when appropriate.

Member Care & Empowerment

  • Provide clear education on posture, functional movement, and how Pilates supports longevity, mobility, and recovery.
  • Encourage members to take ownership of their practice, building confidence and self-awareness.
  • Collaborate with allied health teams and Personal Trainers to support clients with specific rehabilitation or alignment needs.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain the reformer studio environment to the highest standards of safety and professionalism.
  • Participate in audits, workshops, and training sessions to continuously improve skills and delivery.
  • Represent MORROW’s values in every class and interaction with members.

Requirements

Required:

  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience teaching Pilates Reformer in a premium studio, wellness, or clinical environment.
  • Pilates Mat, Reformer & Tower Instructor Certification from a recognised training body (e.g., Polestar, STOTT, BASI, Balanced Body).
  • Strong foundation in alignment, anatomy, and injury-prevention protocols.
  • Proven ability to teach both private sessions and group classes with clarity and safety.
  • Excellent communication and motivational skills, with strong emphasis on precision cueing and mindful teaching.
  • Alignment with MORROW’s mission of education, empowerment, and transformation.

Preferred:

  • Registration with the National Registry of Exercise Professionals (NREP).
  • Safe Sport certification.
  • Experience with rehabilitation or clinical Pilates.
  • Knowledge of working with special populations (pre/post-natal)
  • CPR & AED Certified.

Benefits

This is a career-defining opportunity to shape the future of longevity medicine while working alongside world-class clinicians and technologists. You will contribute to initiatives that directly lead to extending human healthspan while establishing Singapore as the global hub for longevity innovation.

At MORROW, you will not only help define operational excellence but also build the culture, rhythm, and future of interventions. You won't just be joining a team. You will be co-creating tomorrow.

MORROW Health Pte Ltd is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Senior HME RCM Specialist
description:
The Senior HME RCM Specialist is responsible for providing thought leadership, quality assurance, and advanced expertise in billing and collections within Prochant’s HME Division. In addition to managing reimbursement tasks, the senior HME RCM specialist acts as a mentor and trainer for other global reimbursement specialists, supporting their professional growth and development. Serving as a liaison between reimbursement specialists and the Reimbursement Manager, they help streamline operations, resolve challenges, and assist with complex projects. This position is crucial in fostering a collaborative, high-performing team environment while supporting the division’s strategic growth objectives. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Overseeing timely and accurate processing of HME reimbursement claims, ensuring clean claim submission and follow-up with health plans. Work could be in intake, eligibility/prior authorization, qualification, confirmation, billing, denials, AR, held/stopped release, or cash posting.
  • Serve as a flexible, highly adaptable resource across the HME team, stepping in to address emerging challenges, escalated client concerns, process breakdowns, and operational priorities as business needs evolve.
  • Utilizing billing software, payer portals, and data reporting tools to manage outstanding A/R and enhance cash collections.

  • Collaborating with offshore teams and participating in efforts to support organizational needs.
  • Support special projects, process improvement initiatives, and cross-functional efforts that contribute to operational excellence and client satisfaction.

Who Will Be Successful in This Role

The ideal candidate enjoys variety and is energized by solving complex problems. This is not a highly repetitive role where each day follows the same routine. Success in this position requires someone who can quickly assess situations, shift priorities when needed, and confidently tackle new challenges as they arise.

The right person will:

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.
  • Enjoy being the go-to resource for difficult reimbursement and client challenges.
  • Be comfortable pivoting between projects, escalations, mentoring, and operational support throughout the day.
  • Take initiative to identify and resolve issues before they become larger problems.
  • View changing priorities as an opportunity rather than a disruption.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated initiative and problem-solving ability
  • Deep knowledge and experience billing and collecting major medical claims for home HME, ambulatory HME, and/or specialty pharmacy.
  • Ability to demonstrate a clear understanding of CMS 1500 and 837 claim formatting and billing process.

title: Presale Architect / Technology Consultant
description:
You will become a part of Trinetix Presale Team, working together with Sales and Delivery to design compelling and technically credible solutions for our potential clients.

As a Presale Architect / Technology Consultant you will engage with potential clients from the earliest stages to shape solution architecture, validate feasibility, and translate business challenges into robust, scalable technical proposals.

You will take part in building AI-augmented Presale Function together with Trinetix presale and technology experts.

Your key responsibility will be owning the technical vision of the proposed solution and ensuring it is architecturally sound, commercially competitive, and clearly communicated to both technical and business audiences.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in the IT sector, with at least 3 years in a Software Architect or Technical Lead role
  • Strong background as a software architect or senior technical consultant with proven experience designing end-to-end enterprise-grade solutions
  • Proven consulting experience in client-facing roles; skilled at facilitating technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, and solution design reviews with both business and engineering stakeholders
  • Deep expertise in solution architecture, system design, and architectural patterns (SOA, Microservices, event-driven, cloud-native); solid understanding of UX/UI, data, and integration concerns at an architectural level
  • Strong experience leading architecture-level conversations with engineering teams; ability to convert ambiguous business challenges into well-structured technical proposals, reference architectures, and PoC plans
  • Solid understanding of presales dynamics: ability to produce high-quality architectural output under time pressure and ambiguity, making pragmatic trade-off decisions without sacrificing credibility
  • Experience contributing to both informal discovery-driven engagements and formal RFP/RFI responses, including authoring technical sections of proposals
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and to craft compelling architecture narratives
  • Experience engaging with technical and non-technical stakeholders from the USA and/or Europe; comfortable presenting to architects, CTOs, and VP-level executives
  • Proven experience presenting architectural proposals and facilitating technical deep-dives with VP- and CxO-level client stakeholders, including handling tough architecture-related questions on the spot
  • Ability to independently produce well-structured, visually clear architecture documents, diagrams (e.g. C4, UML), and presentation decks — including when design support is not available
  • Advanced level of English or higher

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred, AWS or GCP as a plus) and cloud-native architecture patterns
  • Experience or strong interest in AI/ML solution architecture and its practical implications for enterprise systems
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate solution design, documentation, and presales deliverables
  • Practical knowledge of DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD concepts at the architecture level
  • Domain expertise in Healthcare, Fintech, Logistics, or Telecom would be a strong plus

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the technical lead within the presale process, owning the architecture vision and acting as the primary technical point of contact for potential clients

  • Author the technical sections of presale documents (proposals, architecture decks, RFP/RFI responses, financial models) balancing depth of detail with clarity and persuasiveness
  • Participate in proposal presentation meetings as the primary technical presenter; lead architecture deep-dives and confidently handle technical questions from client engineering and leadership teams
  • Balance the needs and expectations of internal stakeholders (Sales, Delivery, Practice Leads) to ensure technically sound, commercially competitive proposals free of risky over-commitments
  • Contribute to Presale Function development: build and maintain reusable architecture assets, solution templates, technology playbooks, and estimation frameworks
  • Take ownership of key technical decisions during the presale phase and communicate associated risks and trade-offs clearly to both internal teams and clients
  • Continuously collaborate with Trinetix Solution Architecture Practice and Technology Functions contributing into the companies expertise and capabilities

title: Regional Rehabilitation Specialist - Mashriq
description:
This position is priority reserved for internal staff until midnight on Tuesday 18 August 2026.

  • Mission: 12 months
  • Place: Amman - Jordan
  • Starting: September 2026

Humanity & Inclusion is an independent and impartial aid organisation working in situations of poverty and exclusion, conflict and disaster. The organisation works alongside people with disabilities and vulnerable populations, taking action and bearing witness in order to respond to their essential needs, improve their living conditions and promote respect for their dignity and fundamental rights.

Since its creation in 1982, HI has run development & humanitarian projects in more than 55 countries and responded to numerous emergencies. Today, we have a budget of approximately 200 million euros, with 4,000 employees worldwide

At Handicap International-Humanity & Inclusion, we truly believe in the importance of inclusion and diversity within our organisation. This is why we are engaged to a disability policy to encourage the inclusion and integration of people with disabilities.

Please indicate if you require any special accommodation, even at the first interview. For more information about the organisation.

JOB CONTEXT:
HI’s Regional Programme (Mashriq) coordinates missions in 4 different countries (Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, and Syria). The programme is covering the full mandate of HI – emergency, mine action and development with a strong focus on continuum and resilience. The program has a total volume expected for 2026 of 12M Euros with 300 staff.

The main sectors of intervention are integrated rehabilitation and MHPSS, inclusive education, Economic inclusion including basic needs and economic recovery), Humanitarian mines actions and Inclusive Humanitarian Actions/Inclusive governance.

Education is one of the core sector of intervention in most of the countries within the region. HI currently implements inclusive education projects in Jordan, Lebanon and Syria, while seeking to develop interventions in Egypt. In Syria, HI is supporting Education in Emergencies (EiE) partners (international INGOs and local NGOs) to make their EiE intervention inclusive of children with disabilities, through a mix approach of technical capacity building to partners and direct operational support to children with disabilities and their caregivers.

YOUR MISSION:
Based on the evolution of the context in the region, the Regional Rehabilitation Specialist will have to support the development of the Operational strategy and the revision of the sectorial strategy developed in the previous years to be adapted to the evolution of the context, especially in Lebanon.

Under the line management of the Technical Head of Program (THoP), you contribute to the implementation of the mandate of HI and the operational strategy of HI MASHRIQ program in your field of expertise, while respecting the HI DGA policy. You ensure optimal quality and impact of the projects implemented in the countries, through a delegation system with appropriate control mechanisms.
You share with all HI managers the responsibility of a sound management and successful functioning of the global organization. The post holder leverages expertise in Rehabilitation to offer strategic and/or operational support to the countries in MASHRIQ (Lebanon, Palestine, Jordan, Egypt, and Syria), according to needs jointly defined with the THoP and the Global Specialist.

Mission 1: Expertise

1.1 Contributes to the regional strategies and countries mission strategies when relevant in line with the global strategies

1.2 Ensure technical support to projects in line with the global technical frameworks and standards on Rehabilitation

1.3 Support the design and contextualization of technical tools, training, materials and other relevant documents, and disseminate them among the mission/humanitarian regional community (as needed) upon prior validation by the relevant HQ Technical Specialists.

1.4 Ensure technical learning from projects

1.5 Ensure the control & monitoring of the technical quality and the relevance of HI’s activities in the Programmers under Rehabilitation activities

1.6 Ensure compliance of the technical proposition with nexus stakes

1.7 Contributes to the development of research and innovation projects at country and region level, when relevant, in the MHPSS expertise.

1.8 Contribute to the Technical Divisions professional channel animation

Mission 2: Influence

Contribute to the local external prestige and influence of HI’s expertise in the field of expertise and foster technical partnerships between HI and other actors.

Mission 3: Business Development

Ensure the development of major opportunities or new projects in the region in Rehabilitation sector. Be up-to date on the last international practices and directions and opportunities under his sectorial scope. Use this knowledge to guide the mission towards new and more relevant and efficient technical programming. Ensure relevance of technical practices at project design stage and on strategy development.

Mission 4: Emergency preparedness and response

Contribute to the support or implementation of emergency preparedness actions in the region and, during an emergency, adapts his/her working modality to contribute to an effective HI humanitarian response.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE POSITION:

  • The position will require the postholder to travel between the countries of the region and be able to move easily.

Requirements

  • You hold an advanced degree in Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation,
  • You have a minimum of 5 years’ experience between international development and emergency and post crisis environments, in technical position,

· You have proven experience in complex environments as well as in collaboration with national rehabilitation actors at all levels (from services to central and international levels),

title: Software Development Engineer II — Ads Reporting, Programmatic Reporting Interfaces
description:
Amazon Advertising's Measurement and Data Science (MADS) organization delivers campaign measurement and reporting across the advertising business and serves as the scientific center of excellence for measurement algorithm development. Within MADS, the Programmatic Reporting (PREP) team builds the interfaces and engines that turn measurement data into consistent, accurate, and efficient reporting for advertisers and partners — through programmatic interfaces rather than dashboards. Other companies' systems talk to ours to measure and grow their Amazon advertising investment.

We operate at scale. Billions of ad impressions, clicks, and conversion events are processed and summarized every day across petabyte-scale data with millions of transactions per second. Delivering this reliably requires invention ahead of common technologies and event-driven architectures built on AWS.

This SDE II role spans two of our three tier-1 reporting surfaces and the engines behind them:

- Reporting API — the pull surface: an asynchronous API for occasional, experimental, and analytical queries, and the back end to the Unified Report Builder.

- Amazon Marketing Stream — the push surface for recurring, high-volume reporting data.

- The processing engines — including the Offline Engine (Iceberg + Spark on EMR) that computes the data those surfaces deliver.

You will own projects end to end — requirements, system design, implementation, testing, and production support — on systems built with Spark and EMR alongside AWS services including Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions, Kinesis, and DynamoDB. The work is high-ownership and collaborative: you will partner with senior and principal engineers on architecture, and with product managers and technical account managers to translate customer pain points into features. You will also help deliver Unified Reporting as Amazon's single programmatic reporting solution and shift high-volume, recurring consumption from repeated API polling toward Amazon Marketing Stream.

Amazon is investing heavily in a world-class advertising business, and this team is at the forefront of that growth. We are highly motivated, collaborative, and direct, with a strong bias for action and a broad mandate to experiment. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do. If you want to build the next generation of large-scale reporting systems on modern data and AWS technologies, we would like to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
1. Design and build scalable, secure, and reliable features and data solutions across the Reporting API, Amazon Marketing Stream, and the processing engines — from requirements and system design through implementation, testing, and production support.
2. Deep-dive into client and server systems to optimize performance, scalability, maintainability, and extensibility, integrating data across a large number of services.
3. Collaborate with senior and principal engineers on architecture and system design for high-impact, strategic projects, and navigate ambiguity to deliver results.
4. Write clean, maintainable code and raise the bar through peer code reviews and engineering standards.
5. Propose tools, frameworks, and automation adopted across the team, and drive operational excellence through monitoring and continuous improvement.
6. Partner with product managers, technical account managers, technical program managers, and mentees to understand customer needs, elevate the team, and promote engineering excellence.

Shift Leadership and Staff Supervision:

Youth Support and Program Implementation:

  • Ensure daily schedule established with clinical team and routines are implemented, including therapeutic activities, hygiene, meals, school preparation, and bedtime.

  • Ensure treatment plans and TBRI behavior support strategies are followed and integrated into daily care.
  • Provide guidance and backup for behavioral interventions using trauma-informed practices.
  • Respond to crises, support de-escalation, and coordinate post-incident debriefs with clinical staff and any staff involved in the incident as applicable.
  • Maintain a flexible schedule and report on-site or provide coverage as operational needs require, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and emergency situations; role requires availability 24/7 to ensure continuity of care and safety.
  • Reinforce plan of service, treatment goals, and life-skills instruction consistent with individual client and program goals.


Documentation & Communication

  • Accurately complete and maintain all required documentation, including shift notes, incident reports, communication logs, medication logs, and other program-required records.

Safety, Compliance & Medication Management

  • Ensure adherence to licensing standards, agency policies, and COA requirements during each shift

Team Collaboration

  • Participate in all required and additional trainings, certifications, and professional development activities as assigned, including those mandated by regulatory, licensing, or organizational requirements.

The team is small, technical, and collaborative, with direct access to experienced traders, quantitative researchers, engineers, high-quality market data, and modern research infrastructure.

This remote role is open to candidates based across Europe.

Requirements

Responsibilities

- Interest in financial markets is useful, but prior finance experience is not required.

- Applicants from every degree discipline are welcome.

- No prior quantitative finance, trading, or investment-industry experience is required.

- Strong attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic builder who cares about correctness, performance, and maintainability. You enjoy understanding how systems behave under real load, collaborating with demanding technical users, and taking ownership from initial design through testing and production support.

Benefits

title: Transaction Validation Participant - Australia
description:
Who we are

At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the disruptive potential of AI for the world. By combining advanced technology with a global network of talented experts, we make unusable data usable and inference reliable and trustworthy, driving real-world business value at scale.

More than just a workplace, we're a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do, as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.

Our culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-driven: we focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: Australia
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Australia.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.
